library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(42)

barcodes <- read.delim("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
genes <- read.delim("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
counts <- Matrix::readMM("matrix.mtx")
counts <- as(counts, "CsparseMatrix")

gene_names <- if (ncol(genes) >= 2) genes[[2]] else genes[[1]]
gene_names[is.na(gene_names) | gene_names == ""] <- genes[[1]][is.na(gene_names) | gene_names == ""]
rownames(counts) <- make.unique(as.character(gene_names))
colnames(counts) <- as.character(barcodes[[1]])

pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = counts,
  project = "PBMC2700",
  min.cells = 3,
  min.features = 200
)

pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

pbmc <- subset(
  pbmc,
  subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5
)

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc), npcs = 10, verbose = FALSE)

pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

umap_plot <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("PBMC 2,700 cells: Seurat clusters on UMAP")

print(umap_plot)

ggsave("pbmc2700_umap_clusters.png", plot = umap_plot, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) {
      message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message)
      0
    }
  )

  n_exp <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs = 1:n_pcs,
      pN = 0.25,
      pK = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) {
      message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message)
      0
    }
  )

  n_exp <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs = 1:n_pcs,
      pN = 0.25,
      pK = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

seu_df <- run_doubletfinder_safe(
  seu = seu_filtered,
  n_pcs = n_pcs,
  doublet_rate = doublet_rate,
  pK = pK_fixed,
  run_pk_sweep = run_pk_sweep
)

doublet_umap <- DimPlot(
  seu_df,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "doublet_status",
  cols = c("Singlet" = "grey70", "Doublet" = "red")
) + ggtitle("DoubletFinder singlet and doublet calls")

print(doublet_umap)
ggsave("umap_doubletfinder_singlets_doublets.png", doublet_umap, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)

seu_singlets <- subset(
  seu_df,
  cells = colnames(seu_df)[seu_df$doublet_status == "Singlet"]
)

saveRDS(seu_filtered, "seurat_preprocessed_clustered.rds")
saveRDS(seu_df, "seurat_doublet_annotated.rds")
saveRDS(seu_singlets, "seurat_singlets.rds")

write.csv(
  data.frame(cell = colnames(seu_df), doublet_status = seu_df$doublet_status),
  "doublet_calls.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(seu_df@meta.data, "seurat_metadata_with_doublets.csv")
cat("Cells after QC filtering:", ncol(seu_filtered), "\n")
cat("Singlets retained:", ncol(seu_singlets), "\n")
cat("Doublets detected:", ncol(seu_df) - ncol(seu_singlets), "\n")

  "CD4 T cells" = c("IL7R", "CCR7"),

  "NK cells" = c("GNLY", "NKG7")
)

  present <- intersect(markers, rownames(expr))
  if (length(present) == 0) {
    setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(cluster_levels)), cluster_levels)
  } else {
    per_cell_score <- Matrix::colMeans(expr[present, , drop = FALSE])
    tapply(per_cell_score, clusters, mean)[cluster_levels]
  }
})

mt_pattern <- "^MT-"
project_name <- "PBMC"

has_file <- function(pattern) {
  length(list.files(".", pattern = pattern, ignore.case = TRUE)) > 0
}

load_matrix_file <- function(path) {
  ext <- tolower(basename(path))
  if (grepl("\\.rds$", ext)) {
    obj <- readRDS(path)
    if (inherits(obj, "Seurat")) {
      return(obj)
    }
    counts <- obj
  } else if (grepl("\\.csv(\\.gz)?$", ext)) {
    counts <- read.csv(path, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  } else if (grepl("\\.tsv(\\.gz)?$|\\.txt(\\.gz)?$", ext)) {
    counts <- read.delim(path, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported matrix file: ", path)
  }
  rownames(counts) <- make.unique(as.character(rownames(counts)))
  counts <- Matrix(as.matrix(counts), sparse = TRUE)
  CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts,
    project = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path)),
    min.cells = min_cells,
    min.features = min_features
  )
}

load_one_sample <- function(path) {
  sample_name <- make.names(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path)))
  if (dir.exists(path)) {
    counts <- Read10X(data.dir = path)
    seu <- CreateSeuratObject(
      counts = counts,
      project = sample_name,
      min.cells = min_cells,
      min.features = min_features
    )
  } else if (grepl("\\.h5$", path, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    counts <- Read10X_h5(filename = path)
    seu <- CreateSeuratObject(
      counts = counts,
      project = sample_name,
      min.cells = min_cells,
      min.features = min_features
    )
  } else {
    seu <- load_matrix_file(path)
  }
  seu$sample <- sample_name
  seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = mt_pattern)
  seu
}

is_10x_mtx_triplet <- has_file("^matrix\\.mtx(\\.gz)?$") &&
  has_file("^barcodes\\.tsv(\\.gz)?$") &&
  (has_file("^features\\.tsv(\\.gz)?$") || has_file("^genes\\.tsv(\\.gz)?$"))

if (is_10x_mtx_triplet) {
  counts <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")
  seu <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts,
    project = project_name,
    min.cells = min_cells,
    min.features = min_features
  )
  seu$sample <- project_name
  seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = mt_pattern)
} else {
  h5_files <- list.files(".", pattern = "\\.h5$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  rds_files <- list.files(".", pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  matrix_files <- list.files(".", pattern = "\\.(csv|tsv|txt)(\\.gz)?$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  candidate_files <- c(h5_files, rds_files, matrix_files)
  
  tenx_dirs <- list.dirs(".", recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
  tenx_dirs <- tenx_dirs[
    file.exists(file.path(tenx_dirs, "matrix.mtx")) |
      file.exists(file.path(tenx_dirs, "matrix.mtx.gz"))
  ]
  
  sample_paths <- c(candidate_files, tenx_dirs)
  
  if (length(sample_paths) == 0) {
    stop("No supported scRNA-seq input found in the working directory. Expected either a 10X MTX triplet, one or more .h5 files, .rds files, expression matrices, or 10X sample folders.")
  }
  
  sample_list <- lapply(sample_paths, load_one_sample)
  names(sample_list) <- vapply(sample_list, function(x) unique(x$sample)[1], character(1))
  
  if (length(sample_list) == 1) {
    seu <- sample_list[[1]]
  } else {
    common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(sample_list, rownames))
    sample_list <- lapply(sample_list, function(x) subset(x, features = common_genes))
    seu <- merge(
      x = sample_list[[1]],
      y = sample_list[-1],
      add.cell.ids = names(sample_list),
      project = project_name
    )
    seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = mt_pattern)
  }
}

print(FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt"))
dev.off()

seu <- subset(

load_pbmc_data <- function(data_path = ".", input_type = "auto", project_name = "PBMC",
                           min_cells = 3, min_features = 200) {
  if (input_type == "auto") {
    if (dir.exists(data_path) &&
        (file.exists(file.path(data_path, "matrix.mtx")) || file.exists(file.path(data_path, "matrix.mtx.gz"))) &&
        (file.exists(file.path(data_path, "barcodes.tsv")) || file.exists(file.path(data_path, "barcodes.tsv.gz"))) &&
        (file.exists(file.path(data_path, "features.tsv")) || file.exists(file.path(data_path, "features.tsv.gz")) ||
         file.exists(file.path(data_path, "genes.tsv")) || file.exists(file.path(data_path, "genes.tsv.gz")))) {
      input_type <- "mtx"
    } else if (file.exists(data_path) && grepl("\\.h5$", data_path, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      input_type <- "h5"
    } else if (file.exists(data_path) && grepl("\\.rds$", data_path, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      input_type <- "rds"
    } else if (file.exists("filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")) {
      data_path <- "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"
      input_type <- "h5"
    } else {
      h5_files <- list.files(".", pattern = "\\.h5$", full.names = TRUE)
      rds_files <- list.files(".", pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
      if (length(h5_files) == 1) {
        data_path <- h5_files[1]
        input_type <- "h5"
      } else if (length(rds_files) == 1) {
        data_path <- rds_files[1]
        input_type <- "rds"
      } else {
        stop("No supported input detected. Put 10X matrix.mtx/features.tsv/barcodes.tsv in the working directory, or set data_path to a .h5 or .rds file.")
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (input_type == "mtx") {
    counts <- Read10X(data.dir = data_path)
    if (is.list(counts)) {
      if ("Gene Expression" %in% names(counts)) {
        counts <- counts[["Gene Expression"]]
      } else {
        counts <- counts[[1]]
      }
    }
    seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = project_name,
                              min.cells = min_cells, min.features = min_features)
  } else if (input_type == "h5") {
    counts <- Read10X_h5(filename = data_path)
    if (is.list(counts)) {
      if ("Gene Expression" %in% names(counts)) {
        counts <- counts[["Gene Expression"]]
      } else {
        counts <- counts[[1]]
      }
    }
    seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = project_name,
                              min.cells = min_cells, min.features = min_features)
  } else if (input_type == "rds") {
    obj <- readRDS(data_path)
    if (inherits(obj, "Seurat")) {
      seu <- obj
    } else {
      counts <- obj
      if (!inherits(counts, "dgCMatrix")) {
        counts <- Matrix(as.matrix(counts), sparse = TRUE)
      }
      rownames(counts) <- make.unique(as.character(rownames(counts)))
      seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = project_name,
                                min.cells = min_cells, min.features = min_features)
    }
  } else {
    stop("input_type must be one of: auto, mtx, h5, rds")
  }
  
  seu
}

run_standard_seurat_pipeline <- function(seu, mt_pattern = "^MT-", min_feat = 200, max_feat = 6000,
                                         max_mt = 15, n_variable = 2000, n_pcs = 30,
                                         resolution = 0.6, filter_cells = TRUE) {
  DefaultAssay(seu) <- "RNA"
  seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = mt_pattern)
  
  if (filter_cells) {
    seu <- subset(seu, subset = nFeature_RNA >= min_feat & nFeature_RNA <= max_feat & percent.mt <= max_mt)
  }
  
  seu <- NormalizeData(seu, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000, verbose = FALSE)
  seu <- FindVariableFeatures(seu, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = n_variable, verbose = FALSE)
  seu <- ScaleData(seu, vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), verbose = FALSE)
  seu <- RunPCA(seu, npcs = n_pcs, verbose = FALSE)
  seu <- FindNeighbors(seu, dims = 1:n_pcs, verbose = FALSE)
  seu <- FindClusters(seu, resolution = resolution, verbose = FALSE)
  seu <- RunUMAP(seu, dims = 1:n_pcs, verbose = FALSE)
  seu
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 30, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }
  
  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }
  
  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
  }
  
  annotations <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) {
      message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message)
      0
    }
  )
  
  n_exp <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  
  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs = 1:n_pcs,
      pN = 0.25,
      pK = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )
  
  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA
  
  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
  }
  
  seu_df
}

annotate_pbmc_clusters <- function(seu) {
  DefaultAssay(seu) <- "RNA"
  cluster_ids <- levels(Idents(seu))
  
  marker_sets <- list(
    "CD4 T cells" = c("CD3D", "CD3E", "CD4", "IL7R", "CCR7", "LTB"),
    "CD8 T cells" = c("CD3D", "CD3E", "CD8A", "CD8B", "NKG7", "GZMK"),
    "NK cells" = c("NKG7", "GNLY", "KLRD1", "PRF1", "GZMB", "FCGR3A"),
    "B cells" = c("MS4A1", "CD79A", "CD79B", "BANK1", "CD74", "HLA-DRA"),
    "Plasma cells" = c("MZB1", "SDC1", "XBP1", "JCHAIN", "IGHG1", "IGKC"),
    "CD14 monocytes" = c("LYZ", "S100A8", "S100A9", "CTSS", "CD14", "FCN1"),
    "FCGR3A monocytes" = c("LYZ", "FCGR3A", "MS4A7", "LST1", "IFITM3", "AIF1"),
    "Dendritic cells" = c("FCER1A", "CST3", "CLEC10A", "CD1C", "HLA-DPA1", "HLA-DRA"),
    "Plasmacytoid DCs" = c("IL3RA", "GZMB", "SERPINF1", "ITM2C", "CLEC4C", "TCF4"),
    "Platelets" = c("PPBP", "PF4", "GP9", "ITGA2B", "TUBB1", "NRGN"),
    "Proliferating cells" = c("MKI67", "TOP2A", "STMN1", "TYMS", "UBE2C", "HMGB2")
  )
  
  present_marker_sets <- lapply(marker_sets, function(x) intersect(x, rownames(seu)))
  present_marker_sets <- present_marker_sets[lengths(present_marker_sets) > 0]
  
  avg <- AverageExpression(seu, assays = "RNA", layer = "data", return.seurat = FALSE)$RNA
  scores <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(present_marker_sets), ncol = ncol(avg),
                   dimnames = list(names(present_marker_sets), colnames(avg)))
  
  for (ct in names(present_marker_sets)) {
    genes <- present_marker_sets[[ct]]
    scores[ct, ] <- colMeans(avg[genes, , drop = FALSE])
  }
  
  cluster_annotations <- apply(scores, 2, function(x) {
    names(which.max(x))
  })
  
  cluster_annotations <- cluster_annotations[cluster_ids]
  names(cluster_annotations) <- cluster_ids
  
  seu$cell_type <- unname(cluster_annotations[as.character(seu$seurat_clusters)])
  Idents(seu) <- "cell_type"
  
  list(seurat = seu, cluster_annotations = cluster_annotations, annotation_scores = scores)
}

  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) 0
  )
  n_exp <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs = 1:n_pcs,
      pN = 0.25,
      pK = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,

    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )
  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(42)

project_name <- "PBMC"
min_cells <- 3
min_features <- 200
min_feat <- 200
max_feat <- 6000
max_mt <- 15
n_variable <- 2000
n_pcs <- 30
resolution <- 0.5
test_method <- "wilcox"
logfc_threshold <- 0.25
min_pct <- 0.25
only_positive <- TRUE

object_candidates <- c("seu_filtered", "seu", "pbmc", "seurat_obj")
found_objects <- object_candidates[vapply(object_candidates, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]

tenx_files_present <- (
  (file.exists("matrix.mtx") || file.exists("matrix.mtx.gz")) &&
    (file.exists("barcodes.tsv") || file.exists("barcodes.tsv.gz")) &&
    (file.exists("features.tsv") || file.exists("features.tsv.gz") ||
       file.exists("genes.tsv") || file.exists("genes.tsv.gz"))
)

if (length(found_objects) > 0) {
  pbmc <- get(found_objects[1], inherits = TRUE)
} else if (tenx_files_present) {
  counts <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")
  if (is.list(counts)) {
    if ("Gene Expression" %in% names(counts)) {
      counts <- counts[["Gene Expression"]]
    } else {
      counts <- counts[[1]]
    }
  }
  pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts,
    project = project_name,
    min.cells = min_cells,
    min.features = min_features
  )
  pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")
  pbmc <- subset(
    pbmc,
    subset = nFeature_RNA >= min_feat &
      nFeature_RNA <= max_feat &
      percent.mt <= max_mt
  )
} else {
  stop("No Seurat object found in the workspace and no 10X matrix files found in the working directory.")
}

if (!inherits(pbmc, "Seurat")) {
  stop("Input object is not a Seurat object.")
}

if ("RNA" %in% Assays(pbmc)) {
  DefaultAssay(pbmc) <- "RNA"
}

pbmc <- tryCatch({
  if (inherits(pbmc[[DefaultAssay(pbmc)]], "Assay5")) {
    JoinLayers(pbmc)
  } else {
    pbmc
  }
}, error = function(e) pbmc)

has_normalized_data <- tryCatch({
  norm_mat <- GetAssayData(pbmc, assay = DefaultAssay(pbmc), layer = "data")
  nrow(norm_mat) > 0 && ncol(norm_mat) > 0
}, error = function(e) FALSE)

if (!has_normalized_data) {
  pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
}

if (length(VariableFeatures(pbmc)) == 0) {
  pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = n_variable)
}

vars_to_regress <- intersect(c("percent.mt"), colnames(pbmc@meta.data))
if (length(vars_to_regress) == 0) {
  vars_to_regress <- NULL
}

if (!"pca" %in% Reductions(pbmc)) {
  pca_features <- VariableFeatures(pbmc)
  pca_npcs <- min(n_pcs, length(pca_features) - 1, ncol(pbmc) - 1)
  pca_npcs <- max(2, pca_npcs)
  pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = pca_features, vars.to.regress = vars_to_regress)
  pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = pca_features, npcs = pca_npcs)
}

dims_use <- seq_len(min(n_pcs, ncol(Embeddings(pbmc, reduction = "pca"))))

if ("seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(pbmc@meta.data)) {
  Idents(pbmc) <- "seurat_clusters"
} else if (length(levels(Idents(pbmc))) > 1) {
  pbmc$seurat_clusters <- as.character(Idents(pbmc))
  Idents(pbmc) <- "seurat_clusters"
} else {
  pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = dims_use)
  pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = resolution)
  Idents(pbmc) <- "seurat_clusters"
}

if (!"umap" %in% Reductions(pbmc)) {
  pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = dims_use)
}

Idents(pbmc) <- "seurat_clusters"

sc_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  pbmc,
  only.pos = only_positive,
  min.pct = min_pct,
  logfc.threshold = logfc_threshold,
  test.use = test_method
)

fc_col <- intersect(c("avg_log2FC", "avg_logFC"), colnames(sc_markers))[1]

top_markers <- sc_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  arrange(desc(.data[[fc_col]]), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

write.csv(sc_markers, "pbmc_all_cluster_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(top_markers, "pbmc_top10_markers_per_cluster.csv", row.names = FALSE)

pbmc_signatures <- list(
  CD4_T = c("CD3D", "CD3E", "CD3G", "CD4", "IL7R", "CCR7", "LTB", "TCF7", "LEF1", "SELL"),
  CD8_T = c("CD3D", "CD3E", "CD8A", "CD8B", "GZMK", "GZMA", "CCL5", "NKG7", "CST7"),
  NK = c("GNLY", "NKG7", "KLRD1", "KLRF1", "PRF1", "GZMB", "FGFBP2", "SPON2"),
  B = c("MS4A1", "CD79A", "CD79B", "CD19", "BANK1", "CD74", "HLA-DRA", "IGHM"),
  Plasma = c("MZB1", "JCHAIN", "XBP1", "SDC1", "IGKC", "IGHG1", "DERL3"),
  CD14_Monocyte = c("CD14", "LYZ", "LST1", "S100A8", "S100A9", "VCAN", "FCN1", "LGALS3"),
  FCGR3A_Monocyte = c("FCGR3A", "MS4A7", "LST1", "AIF1", "IFITM3", "COTL1", "LILRB1"),
  Dendritic = c("FCER1A", "CST3", "CD1C", "CLEC10A", "HLA-DQA1", "HLA-DPB1", "IRF8"),
  Plasmacytoid_DC = c("IL3RA", "CLEC4C", "GZMB", "IRF7", "TCF4", "LILRA4", "JCHAIN"),
  Platelet = c("PPBP", "PF4", "NRGN", "GP9", "GNG11", "TUBB1"),
  Proliferating = c("MKI67", "TOP2A", "STMN1", "HMGB2", "TYMS", "UBE2C"),
  MAIT = c("TRAV1-2", "KLRB1", "SLC4A10", "IL7R", "NKG7", "CCR6")
)

pbmc_signatures <- lapply(pbmc_signatures, function(x) intersect(x, rownames(pbmc)))
pbmc_signatures <- pbmc_signatures[lengths(pbmc_signatures) > 0]

expr_mat <- GetAssayData(pbmc, assay = DefaultAssay(pbmc), layer = "data")

signature_scores <- sapply(pbmc_signatures, function(genes) {
  Matrix::colMeans(expr_mat[genes, , drop = FALSE])
})

signature_scores <- as.data.frame(signature_scores)
signature_scores$seurat_clusters <- as.character(pbmc$seurat_clusters)

cluster_signature_scores <- aggregate(
  . ~ seurat_clusters,
  data = signature_scores,
  FUN = mean
)

rownames(cluster_signature_scores) <- cluster_signature_scores$seurat_clusters
score_cols <- setdiff(colnames(cluster_signature_scores), "seurat_clusters")

best_signature <- apply(
  cluster_signature_scores[, score_cols, drop = FALSE],
  1,
  function(x) {
    if (all(is.na(x)) || max(x, na.rm = TRUE) <= 0) {

      names(which.max(x))

best_score <- apply(

    } else {
      max(x, na.rm = TRUE)

cluster_to_type[is.na(cluster_to_type)] <- "Unknown"
names(cluster_to_type) <- rownames(cluster_signature_scores)

top5_markers <- sc_markers %>%

run_standard_analysis <- function(obj, assay = "RNA", n_variable = 2000, n_pcs_requested = 30,
                                  resolution = 0.5, score_cc = TRUE,
                                  regress_vars = c("percent.mt", "nCount_RNA")) {
  DefaultAssay(obj) <- assay
  
  obj <- NormalizeData(obj, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000, verbose = FALSE)
  
  if (isTRUE(score_cc) && assay == "RNA") {
    s_genes <- intersect(Seurat::cc.genes$s.genes, rownames(obj))
    g2m_genes <- intersect(Seurat::cc.genes$g2m.genes, rownames(obj))
    if (length(s_genes) > 5 && length(g2m_genes) > 5) {
      obj <- CellCycleScoring(
        obj,
        s.features = s_genes,
        g2m.features = g2m_genes,
        set.ident = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  
  obj <- FindVariableFeatures(
    obj,
    selection.method = "vst",
    nfeatures = n_variable,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  regress_vars <- intersect(regress_vars, colnames(obj@meta.data))
  obj <- ScaleData(
    obj,
    features = VariableFeatures(obj),
    vars.to.regress = regress_vars,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  n_pcs_use <- min(n_pcs_requested, ncol(obj) - 1, length(VariableFeatures(obj)) - 1)
  if (n_pcs_use < 2) {
    stop("Not enough cells/features remain after filtering to run PCA.")
  }
  
  obj <- RunPCA(obj, npcs = n_pcs_use, features = VariableFeatures(obj), verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims = seq_len(n_pcs_use), verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = resolution, verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = seq_len(n_pcs_use), verbose = FALSE)
  obj
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }
  
  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }
  
  if (!"pca" %in% names(seu@reductions)) {
    message("No PCA reduction found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }
  
  n_pcs <- min(n_pcs, ncol(Embeddings(seu, "pca")))
  if (n_pcs < 1) {
    message("No usable PCs found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }
  
  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = seq_len(n_pcs), sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }
  
  annotations <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) {
      message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message)
      0
    }
  )
  
  n_exp <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw): ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)
  
  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs = seq_len(n_pcs),
      pN = 0.25,
      pK = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )
  
  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA
  
  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
  }
  
  seu_df
}

run_integrated_analysis <- function(obj, n_variable = 2000, n_pcs_requested = 30, resolution = 0.5) {
  sample_ids <- unique(as.character(obj$sample_id))
  if (length(sample_ids) < 2) {

  obj_list <- lapply(obj_list, function(x) {
    DefaultAssay(x) <- "RNA"
    x <- NormalizeData(x, verbose = FALSE)
    x <- FindVariableFeatures(x, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = n_variable, verbose = FALSE)
    x
  })
  
  integration_features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = obj_list, nfeatures = n_variable)
  min_cells_per_sample <- min(vapply(obj_list, ncol, integer(1)))
  n_pcs_use <- min(n_pcs_requested, min_cells_per_sample - 1, length(integration_features) - 1)
  
  if (n_pcs_use < 2) {
    return(run_standard_analysis(
      obj = obj,
      assay = "RNA",
      n_variable = n_variable,
      n_pcs_requested = n_pcs_requested,
      resolution = resolution,
      score_cc = score_cell_cycle
    ))
  }
  
  anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(
    object.list = obj_list,
    anchor.features = integration_features,
    dims = seq_len(n_pcs_use),
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors, dims = seq_len(n_pcs_use), verbose = FALSE)
  DefaultAssay(integrated) <- "integrated"
  integrated <- ScaleData(integrated, verbose = FALSE)
  integrated <- RunPCA(integrated, npcs = n_pcs_use, verbose = FALSE)
  integrated <- FindNeighbors(integrated, dims = seq_len(n_pcs_use), verbose = FALSE)
  integrated <- FindClusters(integrated, resolution = resolution, verbose = FALSE)
  integrated <- RunUMAP(integrated, dims = seq_len(n_pcs_use), verbose = FALSE)
  integrated
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) {
      message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message)
      0
    }
  )

  n_exp <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs = 1:n_pcs,
      pN = 0.25,
      pK = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 20, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)

  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) {
      message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message)
      0
    }
  )

  n_exp <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))

  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs = 1:n_pcs,
      pN = 0.25,
      pK = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  seu_df
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
  }

  annotations <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) 0
  )

  n_exp <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs = 1:n_pcs,
      pN = 0.25,
      pK = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

seu_df <- run_doubletfinder_safe(
  seu = seu,
  n_pcs = 10,
  doublet_rate = 0.07,
  pK = 0.01,
  run_pk_sweep = FALSE
)

print(DimPlot(seu_df, reduction = "umap", group.by = "doublet_status") + ggtitle("Singlet vs Doublet"))

seu_singlets <- subset(seu_df, cells = colnames(seu_df)[seu_df$doublet_status == "Singlet"])

saveRDS(seu_df, "seurat_doublet_annotated.rds")
saveRDS(seu_singlets, "seurat_singlets.rds")
write.csv(
  data.frame(cell = colnames(seu_df), doublet_status = seu_df$doublet_status),
  "doublet_calls.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

    }
  )
  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)

  } else {

  }
  seu_df
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
  }

  annotations <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations), error = function(e) 0)
  n_exp <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs = 1:n_pcs,
      pN = 0.25,
      pK = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
  }

  seu_df
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu_obj, expected_doublet_rate = 0.07) {
  seu_obj$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) return(seu_obj)
  out <- tryCatch({
    sweep.res.list <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep_v3(seu_obj, PCs = 1:n_pcs_use, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    nExp <- round(ncol(seu_obj) * expected_doublet_rate)
    homotypic.prop <- 0
    if ("seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu_obj@meta.data)) {
      homotypic.prop <- DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(as.character(seu_obj$seurat_clusters))
    }
    nExp.adj <- round(nExp * (1 - homotypic.prop))
    seu_obj <- DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(seu_obj, PCs = 1:n_pcs_use, pN = 0.25, pK = pK, nExp = nExp.adj, reuse.pANN = NULL, sct = FALSE)
    df_col <- grep("^DF.classifications", colnames(seu_obj@meta.data), value = TRUE)
    if (length(df_col) > 0) seu_obj$doublet_status <- seu_obj@meta.data[[df_col[1]]]
    seu_obj
  }, error = function(e) {
    seu_obj
  })
  out
}

detect_input_type <- function(path = ".") {
  files <- list.files(path, full.names = TRUE)
  if (any(grepl("\\.rds$", files, ignore.case = TRUE))) return("rds")
  if (any(grepl("\\.h5$", files, ignore.case = TRUE))) return("h5")
  if (any(grepl("matrix\\.mtx(\\.gz)?$", basename(files), ignore.case = TRUE))) return("mtx")
  if (any(grepl("\\.txt$|\\.tsv$|\\.csv$", files, ignore.case = TRUE))) return("matrix")
  stop("No supported input files found in the working directory.")
}

load_seurat_input <- function(path = ".", project_name = "PBMC_Seurat") {
  input_type <- detect_input_type(path)
  if (input_type == "rds") {
    rds_file <- list.files(path, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]
    seu <- readRDS(rds_file)

    expr_file <- list.files(path, pattern = "\\.txt$|\\.tsv$|\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]
    exp_mat <- read.table(expr_file, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = ifelse(grepl("\\.csv$", expr_file, ignore.case = TRUE), ",", "\t"), check.names = FALSE)
    counts <- Matrix::Matrix(as.matrix(exp_mat), sparse = TRUE)
    rownames(counts) <- make.unique(rownames(counts))
    seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = project_name, min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
  }
  seu
}

  counts       = counts,

  min.cells    = 3,
  min.features = 200
)

# 2. Quality Control and Filtering
# Compute mitochondrial percentage (using human gene pattern "^MT-")
seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = "^MT-")

# - percent.mt less than 5%

  seu,
  subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5
)

  seu,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor         = 10000,
  verbose              = FALSE
)

  seu,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures        = 2000,

)

# 10. Safe function to run DoubletFinder
run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 15, doublet_rate = 0.07, pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

# Run DoubletFinder
seu_df <- run_doubletfinder_safe(
  seu          = seu_filtered,
  n_pcs        = 15,
  doublet_rate = 0.07,
  pK           = 0.01,

)

}

  annotations <- as.character(seu$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) {
      message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message)
      return(0)
    }
  )
  
  # Estimate expected doublets
  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)
  
  # Run DoubletFinder
  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = pK,
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )
  
  # Dynamically detect classification column
  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA
  
  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }
  
  return(seu_df)
}

# Run the doublet detection
seu_df <- run_doubletfinder_safe(
  seu          = seu_filtered,
  n_pcs        = n_pcs,
  doublet_rate = 0.07,
  pK           = 0.01
)

# 12. Visualise singlet and doublet populations on UMAP

    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"

    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"

  }

    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),

      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)

      return(seu)

  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

counts   <- Matrix::readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Set unique row names using HGNC symbols (second column) and column names using barcodes
rownames(counts) <- make.unique(as.character(genes[[2]]))
colnames(counts) <- as.character(barcodes[[1]])

# Create Seurat object

# Find variable features
seu <- FindVariableFeatures(seu, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
seu <- ScaleData(seu, features = VariableFeatures(seu))

# Run PCA
seu <- RunPCA(seu, features = VariableFeatures(seu), npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)

# Find Neighbors and Clusters
seu <- FindNeighbors(seu, dims = 1:10, verbose = FALSE)
seu <- FindClusters(seu, resolution = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)

# Run UMAP

# Define marker genes for each cell type

  "CD4 T cells" = c("IL7R", "CCR7"),
  "CD14 Monocytes" = c("CD14", "LYZ"),
  "B cells" = c("MS4A1"),
  "CD8 T cells" = c("CD8A"),
  "NK cells" = c("GNLY", "NKG7")
)

# Filter markers to keep only those present in the dataset
markers <- lapply(markers, function(g) intersect(g, rownames(seu)))

# Calculate average expression per cluster for each marker set
avg_expr <- AverageExpression(seu, features = unlist(markers), group.by = "ident", slot = "data")
cluster_averages <- if (is.list(avg_expr)) avg_expr$RNA else avg_expr

# Calculate cell type score per cluster
score_matrix <- sapply(names(markers), function(cell_type) {
  genes_to_use <- markers[[cell_type]]
  if (length(genes_to_use) == 1) {
    return(cluster_averages[genes_to_use, , drop = TRUE])
  } else if (length(genes_to_use) > 1) {
    return(colMeans(cluster_averages[genes_to_use, , drop = FALSE]))
  } else {
    return(rep(0, ncol(cluster_averages)))
  }
})

best_cell_type <- colnames(score_matrix)[apply(score_matrix, 1, which.max)]
names(best_cell_type) <- rownames(score_matrix)

de_markers$significance[de_markers$avg_log2FC < -1 & de_markers$p_val_adj < 0.05] <- "Upregulated in Cluster 3"

)

# 6. Score cell cycle phases

)

# 13. Detect and remove doublets safely using DoubletFinder
run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 20) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    warning("DoubletFinder package not found. Skipping doublet detection and marking all as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    # Parameter sweep to find optimal pK
    sweep.res.list <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats    <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn          <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK             <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    
    # Estimate homotypic doublets
    annotations    <- as.character(seu$seurat_clusters)
    homotypic.prop <- DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations)
    nExp_poi       <- round(0.075 * ncol(seu))  # assuming ~7.5% doublet rate
    nExp_poi.adj   <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))
    
    # Run DoubletFinder
    seu <- DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu, 
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs, 
      pN         = 0.25, 
      pK         = pK, 
      nExp       = nExp_poi.adj, 
      reuse.pANN = NULL, 
      sct        = FALSE
    )
    
    # Dynamically extract classification column
    df_col <- grep("^DF.classifications", colnames(seu@meta.data), value = TRUE)
    if (length(df_col) > 0) {
      seu$doublet_status <- seu@meta.data[[df_col[1]]]
    } else {
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("DoubletFinder failed with error: ", e$message, ". Marking all as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  })
  
  return(seu)
}

seu_filtered <- run_doubletfinder_safe(seu_filtered, n_pcs = n_pcs)

# Filter out doublets if they were found
if ("doublet_status" %in% colnames(seu_filtered@meta.data)) {
  cat("Doublet detection summary:\n")
  print(table(seu_filtered$doublet_status))

# ==========================================
# This script assumes you have a clustered Seurat object named 'pbmc' in your environment.

# pbmc <- your_seurat_object

# Define the two clusters you want to compare
# (These should correspond to active identities in Idents(pbmc))
ident_1 <- "1"  # e.g., "CD14+ Monocytes" or cluster index 1
ident_2 <- "2"  # e.g., "FCGR3A+ Monocytes" or cluster index 2

# Test settings
test_method     <- "wilcox"  # Options: "wilcox", "MAST", "DESeq2", "t"
logfc_threshold <- 0.25      # Minimum log2 fold change
min_pct         <- 0.25      # Minimum fraction of cells expressing the gene in either group

# ==========================================
# DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION ANALYSIS
# ==========================================
message(paste("Running differential expression between cluster", ident_1, "and cluster", ident_2, "..."))

# Find differentially expressed genes between the two specified clusters
de_results <- FindMarkers(
  object          = pbmc,
  ident.1         = ident_1,
  ident.2         = ident_2,
  test.use        = test_method,
  min.pct         = min_pct,
  logfc.threshold = logfc_threshold
)

# Add gene symbols as a column for easier manipulation and plotting
de_results$gene <- rownames(de_results)

# Classify genes based on significance and fold change
de_results <- de_results %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > logfc_threshold  ~ "Upregulated",
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC < -logfc_threshold ~ "Downregulated",
      TRUE                                             ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

  filter(significance == "Upregulated") %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj, desc(avg_log2FC))

  filter(significance == "Downregulated") %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj, avg_log2FC)

print(head(top_downregulated, 5))

# ==============================================================================
# PRODUCTION-READY SEURAT ANALYSIS PIPELINE FOR PBMC scRNA-seq DATA
# ==============================================================================
# This script performs a complete single-sample Seurat analysis workflow:
# 1. Loading raw count data (10X MTX format)
# 2. Quality Control (QC) filtering (mitochondrial content, gene & UMI counts)
# 3. Log-normalisation
# 4. Cell cycle scoring
# 5. Identification of highly variable features
# 6. Scaling and regression of technical covariates
# 7. Linear dimensionality reduction (PCA)
# 8. Graph-based clustering
# 9. Non-linear dimensionality reduction (UMAP)
# 10. Doublet detection and removal using DoubletFinder
# 11. Marker gene identification
# 12. Canonical cell type annotation and visualization
# All outputs (plots and tables) are saved to the current working directory.
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Setup & Reproducibility
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(42)

# Load required libraries explicitly
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)

# Parameters
data_dir     <- "."       # Directory containing barcodes.tsv, features.tsv, matrix.mtx
project_name <- "PBMC_scRNA"
min_cells    <- 3         # Retain genes detected in at least this many cells
min_features <- 200       # Retain cells with at least this many detected genes
max_features <- 2500      # Upper limit of detected genes (to filter multiplets)
max_mt       <- 5         # Maximum percentage of mitochondrial reads per cell
n_variable   <- 2000      # Number of highly variable genes to select
n_pcs        <- 20        # Number of PCs to use for downstream analysis
resolution   <- 0.5       # Clustering resolution
doublet_rate <- 0.07      # Expected doublet rate (typically 5-10% for 10X)

cat("--- Pipeline Initialized ---\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load Count Data & Create Seurat Object
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[Step 1] Loading raw count data...\n")

if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) {
  stop(paste("Data directory", data_dir, "does not exist. Please check your path."))
}

# Read 10X Genomics MTX format (handles unique feature names automatically)
counts <- Read10X(data.dir = data_dir)

# Create Seurat object
seu <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts       = counts,
  project      = project_name,
  min.cells    = min_cells,
  min.features = min_features
)

cat("Initial Seurat Object Created:\n")
print(seu)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Compute Quality Control Metrics
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[Step 2] Computing QC metrics...\n")

# Human mitochondrial genes start with "MT-"
seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = "^MT-")

# Generate QC plots
pdf("01_qc_plots.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
p1 <- VlnPlot(seu, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
p2 <- FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
p3 <- FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
print(p1)
print(p2 + p3)
dev.off()
cat("Saved QC plots to '01_qc_plots.pdf'\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Filter Cells
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[Step 3] Filtering low-quality cells...\n")
n_before <- ncol(seu)

seu_filtered <- subset(
  seu,
  subset = nFeature_RNA > min_features & 
           nFeature_RNA < max_features & 
           percent.mt < max_mt
)

n_after <- ncol(seu_filtered)
cat(paste("Cells before filtering:", n_before, "\n"))
cat(paste("Cells after filtering: ", n_after, "\n"))
cat(paste("Cells removed:         ", n_before - n_after, "\n"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Normalisation
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[Step 4] Normalising data...\n")
seu_filtered <- NormalizeData(
  seu_filtered,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor         = 10000
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Cell Cycle Scoring
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[Step 5] Scoring cell cycle phases...\n")
# Use Seurat's built-in cell cycle markers
s_genes   <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m_genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes

seu_filtered <- CellCycleScoring(
  seu_filtered,
  s.features   = s_genes,
  g2m.features = g2m_genes,
  set.ident    = FALSE
)

cat("Cell cycle phase distribution:\n")
print(table(seu_filtered$Phase))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Identify Highly Variable Features
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[Step 6] Identifying highly variable genes...\n")
seu_filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(
  seu_filtered,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures        = n_variable
)

top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(seu_filtered), 10)
cat("Top 10 variable genes:", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")

pdf("02_variable_features.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
vf_plot <- VariableFeaturePlot(seu_filtered)
vf_plot <- LabelPoints(plot = vf_plot, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
print(vf_plot)
dev.off()
cat("Saved variable features plot to '02_variable_features.pdf'\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Scale Data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[Step 7] Scaling data...\n")
# Scale only the variable features for computational efficiency
seu_filtered <- ScaleData(
  seu_filtered,
  features = VariableFeatures(seu_filtered)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Linear Dimensionality Reduction (PCA)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[Step 8] Running PCA...\n")
seu_filtered <- RunPCA(
  seu_filtered,
  features = VariableFeatures(object = seu_filtered),
  npcs     = 50,
  verbose  = FALSE
)

pdf("03_pca_diagnostics.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
p_elbow <- ElbowPlot(seu_filtered, ndims = 50) + ggtitle("PCA Elbow Plot")
p_dim   <- DimPlot(seu_filtered, reduction = "pca") + ggtitle("PCA Projection")
print(p_elbow + p_dim)
dev.off()
cat("Saved PCA diagnostics to '03_pca_diagnostics.pdf'\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Build kNN/SNN Graph & Cluster Cells
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[Step 9] Clustering cells...\n")
seu_filtered <- FindNeighbors(seu_filtered, dims = 1:n_pcs)
seu_filtered <- FindClusters(seu_filtered, resolution = resolution)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Non-linear Dimensionality Reduction (UMAP)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[Step 10] Running UMAP...\n")
seu_filtered <- RunUMAP(seu_filtered, dims = 1:n_pcs)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Doublet Detection (DoubletFinder)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[Step 11] Running DoubletFinder...\n")

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 20, doublet_rate = 0.07) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder package not installed. Skipping doublet filtration.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No cluster assignments found. Skipping doublet filtration.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  # Homotypic doublet proportion estimation
  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  
  # Run DoubletFinder with standard stable parameter pK = 0.01
  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = 0.01,
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("DoubletFinder execution failed: ", e$message)
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  # Dynamically extract doublet classification column
  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  if (length(df_col) > 0) {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col[1]]])
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

# Perform doublet prediction
seu_df <- run_doubletfinder_safe(seu_filtered, n_pcs = n_pcs, doublet_rate = doublet_rate)

# Plot doublet status
pdf("04_doublet_status.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
p_doublets <- DimPlot(seu_df, reduction = "umap", group.by = "doublet_status", cols = c("Doublet" = "red", "Singlet" = "grey")) + 
  ggtitle("Predicted Doublets")
print(p_doublets)
dev.off()
cat("Saved doublet status plot to '04_doublet_status.pdf'\n")

# Filter out predicted doublets
seu_singlets <- subset(
  seu_df,
  cells = colnames(seu_df)[seu_df$doublet_status == "Singlet"]
)

cat(paste("Cells before doublet removal:", ncol(seu_df), "\n"))
cat(paste("Cells after doublet removal: ", ncol(seu_singlets), "\n"))
cat(paste("Doublets removed:            ", ncol(seu_df) - ncol(seu_singlets), "\n"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Find Marker Genes per Cluster
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[Step 12] Identifying cluster marker genes...\n")
# Ensure active identity is set to the SNN clusters
Idents(seu_singlets) <- "seurat_clusters"

markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  seu_singlets,
  only.pos        = TRUE,
  min.pct         = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25

# Save marker genes table
write.csv(markers, "cluster_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved all cluster markers to 'cluster_markers.csv'\n")

# Extract top 5 markers per cluster for visualization
top5_markers <- markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 5, wt = avg_log2FC)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Cell Type Annotation & Visualization
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[Step 13] Performing cell type annotation...\n")

# Define canonical PBMC marker genes
# CD4+ T: IL7R, CD4
# CD8+ T: CD8A, GZMK
# B cells: MS4A1, CD79A
# NK cells: GNLY, NKG7
# CD14+ Monocytes: CD14, LYZ
# FCGR3A+ Monocytes: FCGR3A, MS4A7
# Dendritic Cells: FCER1A, CST3
# Platelets: PPBP

canonical_markers <- c("IL7R", "CD4", "CD8A", "GZMK", "MS4A1", "GNLY", "NKG7", "CD14", "FCGR3A", "FCER1A", "PPBP")

# Generate marker expression plots
pdf("05_canonical_markers.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)
p_feat <- FeaturePlot(seu_singlets, features = intersect(canonical_markers, rownames(seu_singlets)), ncol = 4)
print(p_feat)
dev.off()
cat("Saved canonical marker feature plots to '05_canonical_markers.pdf'\n")

# Define a mapping of clusters to canonical PBMC cell types based on markers
# Note: In a production run, users should inspect 'cluster_markers.csv' or use SingleR
# to verify these assignments. Here we provide a robust mapping template.
cluster_names <- levels(Idents(seu_singlets))
cell_type_annotations <- setNames(paste("Cluster", cluster_names), cluster_names)

# Attempt to match canonical markers to dynamically assign cell types
for (cl in cluster_names) {
  cl_markers <- markers %>% filter(cluster == cl, p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% pull(gene)
  
  if ("MS4A1" %in% cl_markers) {
    cell_type_annotations[cl] <- "B Cells"

  } else if (any(c("CD8A", "CD8B") %in% cl_markers)) {
    cell_type_annotations[cl] <- "CD8+ T Cells"
  } else if (any(c("IL7R", "CD4") %in% cl_markers)) {
    cell_type_annotations[cl] <- "CD4+ T Cells"
  } else if ("PPBP" %in% cl_markers) {
    cell_type_annotations[cl] <- "Platelets"
  } else if ("FCER1A" %in% cl_markers) {
    cell_type_annotations[cl] <- "Dendritic Cells"

# Assign annotations back to the Seurat object
seu_singlets$cell_type <- cell_type_annotations[as.character(Idents(seu_singlets))]
Idents(seu_singlets) <- "cell_type"

# Final annotated UMAP plot
pdf("06_final_annotated_umap.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
p_final <- DimPlot(seu_singlets, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) + 
  ggtitle("Annotated PBMC scRNA-seq Clusters") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
print(p_final)
dev.off()
cat("Saved final annotated UMAP plot to '06_final_annotated_umap.pdf'\n")

# Save top markers heatmap
pdf("07_top_markers_heatmap.pdf", width = 12, height = 10)
p_heat <- DoHeatmap(seu_singlets, features = top5_markers$gene) + NoLegend()
print(p_heat)
dev.off()
cat("Saved top markers heatmap to '07_top_markers_heatmap.pdf'\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Save Final Seurat Object
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n[Step 14] Saving final Seurat objects...\n")
saveRDS(seu_df, "seurat_doublet_annotated.rds")

# 1. Load data
counts <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")
seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = "PBMC", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# 2. QC
seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = "^MT-")
seu <- subset(seu, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# 3. Preprocessing
seu <- NormalizeData(seu)
seu <- FindVariableFeatures(seu, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
seu <- ScaleData(seu)
seu <- RunPCA(seu)
seu <- FindNeighbors(seu, dims = 1:10)
seu <- FindClusters(seu, resolution = 0.5)
seu <- RunUMAP(seu, dims = 1:10)

# 4. DoubletFinder
# Estimate optimal pK
sweep.res <- paramSweep_v3(seu, PCs = 1:10, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)
pK_val <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Run DoubletFinder
nExp_poi <- round(0.07 * nrow(seu@meta.data))
seu <- doubletFinder_v3(seu, PCs = 1:10, pN = 0.25, pK = pK_val, nExp = nExp_poi, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)

# Rename doublet column dynamically
df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu@meta.data), value = TRUE)
seu$DoubletStatus <- seu[[df_col]]

# 5. Visualise
DimPlot(seu, group.by = "DoubletStatus", reduction = "umap") + 
  ggtitle("Singlet and Doublet Populations")

bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

seu_filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_filtered, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
seu_filtered <- ScaleData(seu_filtered)

    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])

  }

  seu_singlets <- seu_filtered
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07) {

      seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, pN = 0.25, pK = 0.01, nExp = n_exp_adj, reuse.pANN = NULL, sct = FALSE
    )

    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"

  })

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(DoubletFinder)

# Parameters
project_name <- "pbmc_analysis"
min_cells <- 3
min_features <- 200
mt_pattern <- "^MT-" # Use "^mt-" for mouse
n_pcs <- 20
resolution <- 0.5
doublet_rate <- 0.07
seed <- 42

set.seed(seed)

# 1. Load Data
counts <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")
seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = project_name, min.cells = min_cells, min.features = min_features)

# 2. QC Metrics
seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = mt_pattern)

# Visualise QC
p1 <- VlnPlot(seu, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
ggsave("qc_vlnplot.png", p1, width = 12, height = 6)

# 3. Filter Cells
seu <- subset(seu, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# 4. Normalise and Variable Features
seu <- NormalizeData(seu)
seu <- FindVariableFeatures(seu, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# 5. Scale and PCA
all.genes <- rownames(seu)
seu <- ScaleData(seu, features = all.genes)
seu <- RunPCA(seu, features = VariableFeatures(object = seu))

# 6. Clustering and UMAP
seu <- FindNeighbors(seu, dims = 1:n_pcs)
seu <- FindClusters(seu, resolution = resolution)
seu <- RunUMAP(seu, dims = 1:n_pcs)

# 7. Doublet Detection
# Prepare for DoubletFinder
sweep.res <- paramSweep_v3(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)
pk_val <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

nExp_poi <- round(doublet_rate * nrow(seu@meta.data))
seu <- doubletFinder_v3(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, pN = 0.25, pK = pk_val, nExp = nExp_poi, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)
colnames(seu@meta.data)[ncol(seu@meta.data)] <- "DF.classifications"

# Filter doublets
seu <- subset(seu, subset = DF.classifications == "Singlet")

# 8. Marker Genes
seu.markers <- FindAllMarkers(seu, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
write.csv(seu.markers, "marker_genes.csv")

# 9. Final Visualisation
p2 <- DimPlot(seu, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Final Clustering")
ggsave("umap_clusters.png", p2, width = 8, height = 6)

# Save final object
saveRDS(seu, file = "final_seurat_object.rds")

min_cells        <- 3
min_features     <- 200
mt_pattern       <- "^MT-"
min_feat         <- 200
max_feat         <- 2500
max_mt           <- 5
scale_factor     <- 10000
n_variable       <- 2000
selection_method <- "vst"
n_pcs_compute    <- 50
n_pcs_print      <- 5
n_features_print <- 5

set.seed(42)

# Load count data and create Seurat object
counts <- Read10X(data.dir = data_path)
seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = project_name,
                          min.cells = min_cells, min.features = min_features)
cat("Seurat object created\n")
cat("Genes: ", nrow(seu), "\n")
cat("Cells: ", ncol(seu), "\n")
print(seu)

# QC metrics
seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = mt_pattern)
print(summary(seu@meta.data[, c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt")]))
VlnPlot(seu, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
print(plot1 + plot2)

# Filter low-quality cells
n_before <- ncol(seu)
keep <- seu$nFeature_RNA > min_feat &
        seu$nFeature_RNA < max_feat &
        seu$percent.mt   < max_mt
seu_filtered <- subset(seu, cells = colnames(seu)[keep])
cat("Cells before filtering:", n_before, "\n")
cat("Cells after filtering: ", ncol(seu_filtered), "\n")

# Normalise
seu_filtered <- NormalizeData(seu_filtered,
                              normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                              scale.factor = scale_factor)

# Identify highly variable genes (top 2000)
seu_filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_filtered,
                                     selection.method = selection_method,
                                     nfeatures = n_variable)
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(seu_filtered), 10)
cat("Top 10 variable genes:", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")
vplot1 <- VariableFeaturePlot(seu_filtered)
vplot2 <- LabelPoints(plot = vplot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE,
                      xnudge = 0, ynudge = 0)
print(vplot2)

# Scale data
seu_filtered <- ScaleData(seu_filtered, features = VariableFeatures(seu_filtered))

# PCA using the top 2000 variable genes
seu_filtered <- RunPCA(seu_filtered,
                       features = VariableFeatures(object = seu_filtered),
                       npcs = n_pcs_compute,
                       verbose = FALSE)
print(seu_filtered[["pca"]], dims = 1:n_pcs_print, nfeatures = n_features_print)
VizDimLoadings(seu_filtered, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca")
DimPlot(seu_filtered, reduction = "pca") + NoLegend()
DimHeatmap(seu_filtered, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)

# Elbow plot to determine number of PCs
print(ElbowPlot(seu_filtered, ndims = n_pcs_compute))
cat("Inspect the elbow plot to choose the number of principal components for downstream steps\n")

set.seed(42)

# PARAMETERS
data_path    <- "."
project_name <- "pbmc3k"
min_cells    <- 3
min_features <- 200
mt_pattern   <- "^MT-"
min_feat     <- 200
max_feat     <- 2500
max_mt       <- 5
n_variable   <- 2000
n_pcs        <- 10
resolution   <- 0.5

# Load count data and create Seurat object (10X MTX, handles genes.tsv / features.tsv)
counts <- Read10X(data.dir = data_path)
seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = project_name,
                          min.cells = min_cells, min.features = min_features)

# QC metrics
seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = mt_pattern)

# Filter low-quality cells
keep <- seu$nFeature_RNA > min_feat &
        seu$nFeature_RNA < max_feat &
        seu$percent.mt   < max_mt
seu_filtered <- subset(seu, cells = colnames(seu)[keep])

# Normalise
seu_filtered <- NormalizeData(seu_filtered,
                              normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                              scale.factor = 10000)

# Highly variable genes
seu_filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_filtered,
                                     selection.method = "vst",
                                     nfeatures = n_variable)

# Scale data
seu_filtered <- ScaleData(seu_filtered, features = VariableFeatures(seu_filtered))

# PCA
seu_filtered <- RunPCA(seu_filtered,
                       features = VariableFeatures(object = seu_filtered),
                       npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)

seu_filtered <- FindNeighbors(seu_filtered, dims = 1:n_pcs,
                              reduction = "pca", verbose = FALSE)

                             algorithm = 1, verbose = FALSE)

DimPlot(seu_filtered, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Clusters (res = ", resolution, ", ", n_pcs, " PCs)"))

library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Reproducibility
seed <- 42
set.seed(seed)
cat("Using seed:", seed, "\n")

# PARAMETERS
data_path       <- "."
project_name    <- "pbmc3k"
min_cells       <- 3
min_features    <- 200
mt_pattern      <- "^MT-"
min_feat        <- 200
max_feat        <- 2500
min_counts      <- 0
max_counts      <- Inf
max_mt          <- 5
scale_factor    <- 10000
n_variable      <- 2000
n_pcs           <- 20
resolution      <- 0.5
logfc_threshold <- 0.25
min_pct         <- 0.25
only_positive   <- TRUE
output_file     <- "all_cluster_markers.csv"

# 1. Load data (10X MTX; Read10X handles unique feature names)
counts <- Read10X(data.dir = data_path)
seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = project_name,
                          min.cells = min_cells, min.features = min_features)
cat("Genes:", nrow(seu), " Cells:", ncol(seu), "\n")

# 2. QC metrics
seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = mt_pattern)
print(summary(seu@meta.data[, c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt")]))
VlnPlot(seu, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") +
  FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")

# 3. Filter cells
n_before <- ncol(seu)
keep <- seu$nFeature_RNA > min_feat &
        seu$nFeature_RNA < max_feat &
        seu$percent.mt   < max_mt
if (min_counts > 0)        keep <- keep & seu$nCount_RNA > min_counts
if (is.finite(max_counts)) keep <- keep & seu$nCount_RNA < max_counts
seu_filtered <- subset(seu, cells = colnames(seu)[keep])
cat("Cells before:", n_before, " after:", ncol(seu_filtered), "\n")

# 4. Normalise
seu_filtered <- NormalizeData(seu_filtered, normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                              scale.factor = scale_factor)

# 5. Variable features
seu_filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_filtered, selection.method = "vst",
                                     nfeatures = n_variable)
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(seu_filtered), 10)
LabelPoints(plot = VariableFeaturePlot(seu_filtered), points = top10, repel = TRUE)

# 6. Scale data
seu_filtered <- ScaleData(seu_filtered, features = VariableFeatures(seu_filtered))

# 7. PCA
seu_filtered <- RunPCA(seu_filtered, features = VariableFeatures(seu_filtered),
                       npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)
ElbowPlot(seu_filtered, ndims = 50)

# 8. Neighbours
seu_filtered <- FindNeighbors(seu_filtered, dims = 1:n_pcs, reduction = "pca",
                              verbose = FALSE)

# 9. Clustering
seu_filtered <- FindClusters(seu_filtered, resolution = resolution, algorithm = 1,
                             verbose = FALSE)
print(table(Idents(seu_filtered)))

# 10. UMAP
seu_filtered <- RunUMAP(seu_filtered, dims = 1:n_pcs, reduction = "pca",
                        verbose = FALSE)
DimPlot(seu_filtered, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle(paste0("UMAP (", n_pcs, " PCs)"))

# 11. Marker genes
sc_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  seu_filtered,
  only.pos        = only_positive,
  min.pct         = min_pct,
  logfc.threshold = logfc_threshold,
  test.use        = "wilcox"
)

top_markers <- sc_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > logfc_threshold) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  ungroup()
print(top_markers)

write.csv(sc_markers, file = output_file, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Marker table saved to:", output_file, "\n")

top_heatmap <- sc_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > logfc_threshold) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()
DoHeatmap(seu_filtered, features = top_heatmap$gene) + NoLegend()

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
