  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }
  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }
  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }
  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )
  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, pN = 0.25, pK = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp = n_exp_adj, reuse.pANN = NULL, sct = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )
  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA
  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }
  return(seu_df)
}

de_results$significant[de_results$avg_log2FC < -lfc_cut & de_results$p_val_adj < padj_cut] <- "Up in cluster 3"

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# PARAMETERS
input_type <- "mtx"          # "rds", "mtx", or "h5"
data_dir   <- "."            # working directory containing the sample files

min_cells    <- 3
min_features <- 200
mt_pattern   <- "^MT-"       # "^MT-" human PBMC, "^mt-" mouse

min_feat <- 200
max_feat <- 2500
max_mt   <- 5

n_pcs              <- 20
resolution         <- 0.5
integration_method <- "cca"
reduction_type     <- "rpca"
min_common_genes   <- 5000

set.seed(42)
cat("Seed in use: 42\n")

# Sample metadata table — one row per PBMC sample (3 files in the working directory)
sample_metadata <- data.frame(
  file = c("pbmc1", "pbmc2", "pbmc3"),   # replace with your actual file/folder names
  name = c("PBMC1", "PBMC2", "PBMC3"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Load each sample, create Seurat object, add metadata, compute percent.mt
load_sample <- function(i, sample_metadata, data_dir, input_type,
                        min_cells, min_features) {
  filepath <- file.path(data_dir, sample_metadata$file[i])

  if (input_type == "rds") {
    counts <- readRDS(filepath)
    if (inherits(counts, "Seurat")) return(counts)
  } else if (input_type == "mtx") {
    counts <- Read10X(data.dir = filepath)
  } else if (input_type == "h5") {
    counts <- Read10X_h5(filename = filepath)
  }

  seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = sample_metadata$name[i],
                            min.cells = min_cells, min.features = min_features)
  return(seu)
}

sample_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(sample_metadata)), function(i) {
  seu <- load_sample(i, sample_metadata, data_dir, input_type,
                     min_cells, min_features)

  for (col in setdiff(colnames(sample_metadata), "file")) {
    seu[[col]] <- sample_metadata[[col]][i]
  }

  seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = mt_pattern)

  cat("Loaded:", sample_metadata$name[i],
      "| Cells:", ncol(seu),
      "| Genes:", nrow(seu), "\n")
  return(seu)
})

names(sample_list) <- sample_metadata$name

# QC violin plots per sample
for (nm in names(sample_list)) {
  print(VlnPlot(sample_list[[nm]],
                features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt")) +
          ggtitle(nm))
}

# Filter low-quality cells per sample
sample_list <- lapply(sample_list, function(seu) {
  subset(seu, subset = nFeature_RNA > min_feat &
                       nFeature_RNA < max_feat &
                       percent.mt < max_mt)
})

# Find common gene set across all samples
cat("── Gene set compatibility check ──\n")
gene_counts <- sapply(sample_list, nrow)
print(gene_counts)

common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(sample_list, rownames))
cat("Common genes across all samples:", length(common_genes), "\n")

n_lost <- max(gene_counts) - length(common_genes)
if (n_lost > 0) {
  warning(paste0(n_lost, " genes removed because absent in one or more samples."))
}
if (length(common_genes) < min_common_genes) {
  warning(paste0("Only ", length(common_genes), " common genes found — fewer than recommended ", min_common_genes, "."))
}

sample_list <- lapply(sample_list, function(seu) subset(seu, features = common_genes))
cat("All samples subset to", length(common_genes), "common genes.\n\n")

# Preprocess each sample individually
preprocess_sample <- function(seu) {
  seu %>%
    NormalizeData(verbose = FALSE) %>%
    FindVariableFeatures(verbose = FALSE) %>%
    ScaleData(verbose = FALSE) %>%
    RunPCA(verbose = FALSE)
}

cat("Preprocessing each sample individually...\n")
sample_list_processed <- lapply(sample_list, preprocess_sample)
cat("Preprocessing complete.\n\n")

# Integrate (CCA / RPCA anchors)
cat("Finding integration anchors (", reduction_type, ")...\n")
anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(
  object.list = sample_list_processed,
  dims        = 1:n_pcs,
  reduction   = reduction_type
)
cat("Integrating data...\n")
integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors, dims = 1:n_pcs) %>%
  ScaleData(verbose = FALSE) %>%
  RunPCA(verbose = FALSE) %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:n_pcs, verbose = FALSE) %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:n_pcs, verbose = FALSE) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = resolution, verbose = FALSE)

DefaultAssay(integrated) <- "integrated"
cat("Default assay set to 'integrated'. Switch to 'RNA' for marker finding / DE.\n")

# Report and visualise
cat("\n── Integration complete ──\n")
cat("Cells:    ", ncol(integrated), "\n")
cat("Clusters: ", length(levels(Idents(integrated))), "\n")

print(ElbowPlot(integrated, ndims = 30))

print(DimPlot(integrated, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident") +
        ggtitle("UMAP by sample"))

print(DimPlot(integrated, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE) +
        ggtitle("UMAP by cluster"))

# Doublet detection (safe wrapper with fallback)
run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu_obj, n_pcs, doublet_rate = 0.07) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE) ||
      !"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu_obj@meta.data)) {
    seu_obj$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu_obj)
  }
  result <- tryCatch({
    sweep_res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu_obj, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep_stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep_res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep_stats)
    pK_opt      <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    annotations <- as.character(seu_obj$seurat_clusters)
    homotypic   <- DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations)
    nExp        <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu_obj))
    nExp_adj    <- round(nExp * (1 - homotypic))
    seu_obj <- DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(seu_obj, PCs = 1:n_pcs, pN = 0.25,
                                            pK = pK_opt, nExp = nExp_adj,
                                            reuse.pANN = NULL, sct = FALSE)
    df_col <- grep("^DF.classifications", colnames(seu_obj@meta.data), value = TRUE)[1]
    seu_obj$doublet_status <- seu_obj@meta.data[[df_col]]
    seu_obj
  }, error = function(e) {
    seu_obj$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    seu_obj
  })
  result
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }
  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }
  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }
  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 })
  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, pN = 0.25, pK = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp = n_exp_adj, reuse.pANN = NULL, sct = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    })
  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA
  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }
  return(seu_df)
}

        seu$nFeature_RNA < max_feat &

        ggtitle(paste0("UMAP (", n_pcs, " PCs)")))

# ---- 11. Doublet detection ----
run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                    pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"; return(seu)
  }
  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"; return(seu)
  }
  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }
  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
                             error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 })
  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, pN = 0.25,
                                 pK = as.numeric(pK), nExp = n_exp_adj,
                                 reuse.pANN = NULL, sct = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"; return(seu)
    })
  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA
  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }
  return(seu_df)
}

seu_df <- run_doubletfinder_safe(seu = seu_filtered, n_pcs = n_pcs,
                                 doublet_rate = doublet_rate,
                                 pK = pK_fixed, run_pk_sweep = run_pk_sweep)

if ("umap" %in% names(seu_df@reductions)) {
  print(DimPlot(seu_df, reduction = "umap", group.by = "doublet_status") +
          ggtitle("Doublet status"))
}
seu_singlets <- subset(seu_df, cells = colnames(seu_df)[seu_df$doublet_status == "Singlet"])
cat("Singlets retained:", ncol(seu_singlets),
    " Doublets removed:", ncol(seu_df) - ncol(seu_singlets), "\n")

# ---- 12. Marker genes ----
Idents(seu_singlets) <- "seurat_clusters"

  slice_head(n = 5) %>% ungroup()

write.csv(sc_markers, "all_cluster_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)

feature_genes <- c("MS4A1", "GNLY", "CD3E", "CD14", "FCER1A",
                   "FCGR3A", "LYZ", "PPBP", "CD8A")
feature_genes <- feature_genes[feature_genes %in% rownames(seu_singlets)]
print(FeaturePlot(seu_singlets, features = feature_genes))
print(VlnPlot(seu_singlets, features = feature_genes))

top_heatmap <- sc_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > 0.25) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>% ungroup()
print(DoHeatmap(seu_singlets, features = top_heatmap$gene) + NoLegend())

# ---- 13. Cell type annotation (SingleR) ----
if (requireNamespace("SingleR", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("celldex", quietly = TRUE)) {

process_and_detect_doublets <- function(seu, nm) {
  cat("\n=== Processing", nm, "===\n")

  n_before <- ncol(seu)

          seu$percent.mt   < max_mt

  seu <- ScaleData(seu)
  seu <- RunPCA(seu, npcs = n_pcs, verbose = FALSE)
  seu <- FindNeighbors(seu, dims = 1:n_pcs)
  seu <- FindClusters(seu, resolution = resolution)
  seu <- RunUMAP(seu, dims = 1:n_pcs)

  seu <- run_doubletfinder_safe(
    seu          = seu,
    n_pcs        = n_pcs,
    doublet_rate = doublet_rate,
    pK           = pK_fixed,
    run_pk_sweep = run_pk_sweep

    print(DimPlot(seu, reduction = "umap", group.by = "doublet_status") +

library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================================
# PARAMETERS
# ============================================================
seed          <- 42
data_dir      <- "."          # 10X Cell Ranger MTX folder in working directory
project_name  <- "pbmc"
min_cells     <- 3
min_features  <- 200

mt_pattern    <- "^MT-"       # human mitochondrial genes

min_feat      <- 200
max_feat      <- 2500
min_counts    <- 800
max_counts    <- Inf
max_mt        <- 5

norm_method   <- "lognorm"
scale_factor  <- 10000

regress_cell_cycle <- FALSE

n_variable    <- 2000
selection_method <- "vst"

vars_to_regress <- NULL

n_pcs_compute <- 50
n_pcs         <- 20           # set from elbow plot

resolution    <- 0.5
algorithm     <- 1

doublet_rate  <- 0.07
pK_fixed      <- 0.01
run_pk_sweep  <- FALSE

test_method     <- "wilcox"
logfc_threshold <- 0.25
min_pct         <- 0.25
only_positive   <- TRUE
top_n_heatmap   <- 10

feature_genes <- c("MS4A1", "GNLY", "CD3E", "CD14", "FCER1A",
                   "FCGR3A", "LYZ", "PPBP", "CD8A")

# ============================================================
# 1. Reproducibility
# ============================================================
set.seed(seed)
cat("Seed set to:", seed, "\n")
print(sessionInfo())

# ============================================================
# 2. Load count data and create Seurat object
# ============================================================
counts <- Read10X(data.dir = data_dir)
seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = project_name,
                          min.cells = min_cells, min.features = min_features)
cat("Seurat object created\n")
cat("Genes:", nrow(seu), " Cells:", ncol(seu), "\n")
print(seu)

# ============================================================
# 3. QC metrics
# ============================================================
seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = mt_pattern)
cat("QC metrics summary:\n")
print(summary(seu@meta.data[, c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt")]))

qc_vln <- VlnPlot(seu, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
ggsave("qc_violin.png", qc_vln, width = 12, height = 5)

p1 <- FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
p2 <- FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
ggsave("qc_scatter.png", p1 + p2, width = 12, height = 5)

# ============================================================
# 4. Filter low-quality cells
# ============================================================
n_before <- ncol(seu)
keep <- seu$nFeature_RNA > min_feat &
        seu$nFeature_RNA < max_feat &
        seu$percent.mt   < max_mt
if (min_counts > 0)        keep <- keep & seu$nCount_RNA > min_counts
if (is.finite(max_counts)) keep <- keep & seu$nCount_RNA < max_counts

seu_filtered <- subset(seu, cells = colnames(seu)[keep])
cat("Cells before filtering:", n_before, "\n")
cat("Cells after filtering: ", ncol(seu_filtered), "\n")
cat("Cells removed:         ", n_before - ncol(seu_filtered), "\n")

# ============================================================
# 5. Normalise
# ============================================================
seu_filtered <- NormalizeData(seu_filtered,
                              normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                              scale.factor = scale_factor)
cat("Log-normalisation complete\n")

# ============================================================
# 6. Cell cycle scoring (after normalisation)
# ============================================================

g2m_genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes
seu_filtered <- CellCycleScoring(seu_filtered,

cat("Cell cycle phase distribution:\n")
print(table(seu_filtered$Phase))

# ============================================================
# 7. Variable genes

seu_filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_filtered,
                                     selection.method = selection_method,
                                     nfeatures = n_variable)
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(seu_filtered), 10)
cat("Top 10 variable genes:", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")
vf_plot <- LabelPoints(plot = VariableFeaturePlot(seu_filtered),

# ============================================================
# 8. Scale data

                          vars.to.regress = vars_to_regress)
cat("Scaling complete\n")

# ============================================================
# 9. PCA and elbow plot
# ============================================================

                       features = VariableFeatures(object = seu_filtered),
                       npcs = n_pcs_compute, verbose = FALSE)
print(seu_filtered[["pca"]], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)
ggsave("pca_dimplot.png", DimPlot(seu_filtered, reduction = "pca") + NoLegend(),
       width = 7, height = 6)
ggsave("elbow_plot.png", ElbowPlot(seu_filtered, ndims = n_pcs_compute),
       width = 7, height = 5)

# ============================================================
# 10. Neighbour graph
# ============================================================

                              reduction = "pca", verbose = FALSE)
cat("kNN/SNN graph built using", n_pcs, "PCs\n")

# ============================================================
# 11. Clustering
# ============================================================
seu_filtered <- FindClusters(seu_filtered, resolution = resolution,
                             algorithm = algorithm, verbose = FALSE)
cat("Cluster sizes:\n")
print(table(Idents(seu_filtered)))

# ============================================================
# 12. UMAP
# ============================================================
seu_filtered <- RunUMAP(seu_filtered, dims = 1:n_pcs,
                        reduction = "pca", verbose = FALSE)
umap_plot <- DimPlot(seu_filtered, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle(paste0("UMAP (", n_pcs, " PCs, res = ", resolution, ")"))
ggsave("umap_clusters.png", umap_plot, width = 8, height = 6)

# ============================================================
# 13. Doublet detection (DoubletFinder)
# ============================================================
run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                    pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }
  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }
  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }
  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
                             error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 })
  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)
  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, pN = 0.25,
                                 pK = as.numeric(pK), nExp = n_exp_adj,
                                 reuse.pANN = NULL, sct = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"; return(seu)
    })
  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA
  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }
  return(seu_df)
}

seu_df <- run_doubletfinder_safe(seu = seu_filtered, n_pcs = n_pcs,
                                 doublet_rate = doublet_rate,
                                 pK = pK_fixed, run_pk_sweep = run_pk_sweep)

if ("umap" %in% names(seu_df@reductions)) {

cat("Doublets removed: ", ncol(seu_df) - ncol(seu_singlets), "\n")

saveRDS(seu_df, "seurat_doublet_annotated.rds")
write.csv(data.frame(cell = colnames(seu_df), doublet_status = seu_df$doublet_status),

write.csv(sc_markers, file = "all_cluster_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Marker table saved to: all_cluster_markers.csv\n")

top_markers <- sc_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > logfc_threshold) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>% ungroup()
print(top_markers)

valid_genes <- feature_genes[feature_genes %in% rownames(seu_filtered)]
if (length(valid_genes) > 0) {
  ggsave("marker_featureplot.png", FeaturePlot(seu_filtered, features = valid_genes),
         width = 12, height = 10)
  ggsave("marker_violin.png", VlnPlot(seu_filtered, features = valid_genes),

}

top_heatmap <- sc_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > logfc_threshold) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n_heatmap) %>% ungroup()

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                    pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"; return(seu)
  }
  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"; return(seu)
  }
  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }
  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
                             error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 })
  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, pN = 0.25,
                                 pK = as.numeric(pK), nExp = n_exp_adj,
                                 reuse.pANN = NULL, sct = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"; return(seu)
    })
  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA
  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }
  return(seu_df)
}

                             test.use = "wilcox")
top_markers <- sc_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > logfc_threshold) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  ungroup()

if (length(valid_genes) > 0) {
  ggsave("marker_featureplot.png", FeaturePlot(seu_filtered, features = valid_genes),
         width = 12, height = 10)
  ggsave("marker_vlnplot.png", VlnPlot(seu_filtered, features = valid_genes),
         width = 12, height = 10)
}

top_heatmap <- sc_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > logfc_threshold) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n_heatmap) %>%
  ungroup()
ggsave("marker_heatmap.png",
       DoHeatmap(seu_filtered, features = top_heatmap$gene) + NoLegend(),
       width = 12, height = 12)

# ============================================================
# 15. Cell type annotation (SingleR automated, with manual fallback)
# ============================================================
if (requireNamespace("SingleR", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("celldex", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(SingleR)
  library(celldex)
  ref <- celldex::HumanPrimaryCellAtlasData()
  if (inherits(seu_filtered[["RNA"]], "Assay5")) {
    seu_filtered[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seu_filtered[["RNA"]])
  }
  DefaultAssay(seu_filtered) <- "RNA"
  rna_matrix <- GetAssayData(seu_filtered, layer = "data")
  singler_results <- SingleR(test = rna_matrix, ref = ref, labels = ref$label.main)
  seu_filtered <- AddMetaData(seu_filtered, metadata = singler_results$labels,
                              col.name = "SingleR_Labels")
  ann_plot <- DimPlot(seu_filtered, reduction = "umap",
                      group.by = "SingleR_Labels", label = TRUE) +
    ggtitle("UMAP — SingleR cell type annotation")
  ggsave("umap_annotated.png", ann_plot, width = 10, height = 8)
} else {
  message("SingleR/celldex not available — skipping automated annotation. ",
          "Annotate manually using marker table.")
}

# ============================================================
saveRDS(seu_filtered, "seurat_annotated.rds")
cat("Analysis complete. Final object saved to seurat_annotated.rds\n")

data_dir     <- "."
project_name <- "pbmc3k"
min_cells    <- 3
min_features <- 200
max_feat     <- 2500
max_mt       <- 5
n_variable   <- 2000
n_pcs        <- 10
resolution   <- 0.5

# 1. Load data (barcodes.tsv, genes.tsv, matrix.mtx in working directory)
counts <- Read10X(data.dir = data_dir)
seu <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts       = counts,
  project      = project_name,
  min.cells    = min_cells,
  min.features = min_features
)
cat("Seurat object created\n")
print(seu)

# 2. QC metrics
seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = "^MT-")

VlnPlot(seu, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")

# 3. Filter low-quality cells
seu_filtered <- subset(
  seu,
  subset = nFeature_RNA > min_features & nFeature_RNA < max_feat & percent.mt < max_mt
)
cat("Cells before filtering:", ncol(seu), " After filtering:", ncol(seu_filtered), "\n")

# 4. Normalise
seu_filtered <- NormalizeData(seu_filtered, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# 5. Identify highly variable genes
seu_filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_filtered, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = n_variable)

top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(seu_filtered), 10)
vplot <- VariableFeaturePlot(seu_filtered)
LabelPoints(plot = vplot, points = top10, repel = TRUE)

# 6. Scale data
all_genes <- rownames(seu_filtered)
seu_filtered <- ScaleData(seu_filtered, features = all_genes)

# 7. Linear dimensionality reduction - PCA
seu_filtered <- RunPCA(
  seu_filtered,
  features = VariableFeatures(object = seu_filtered),
  npcs     = 50,
  verbose  = FALSE
)
ElbowPlot(seu_filtered, ndims = 50)

# 8. Build kNN/SNN neighbour graph using first 10 PCs
seu_filtered <- FindNeighbors(
  seu_filtered,
  dims      = 1:n_pcs,
  reduction = "pca",
  verbose   = FALSE
)

# 9. Cluster cells
seu_filtered <- FindClusters(
  seu_filtered,
  resolution = resolution,
  algorithm  = 1,
  verbose    = FALSE
)

cat("Cluster sizes:\n")
print(table(Idents(seu_filtered)))
cat("Total clusters:", length(levels(Idents(seu_filtered))), "\n")

# 10. Non-linear embedding - UMAP using first 10 PCs
seu_filtered <- RunUMAP(
  seu_filtered,
  dims      = 1:n_pcs,
  reduction = "pca",
  verbose   = FALSE
)

# 11. Visualise clusters on UMAP
DimPlot(seu_filtered, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle(paste0("PBMC Clusters (UMAP, ", n_pcs, " PCs, resolution = ", resolution, ")"))

# Final processed object
seu_final <- seu_filtered
print(seu_final)

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

set.seed(42)

# PARAMETERS
data_dir        <- "."
project_name    <- "pbmc3k"
min_cells       <- 3
min_features    <- 200
min_feat        <- 200
max_feat        <- 2500
max_mt          <- 5
n_variable      <- 2000
n_pcs           <- 20
resolution      <- 0.5
mt_pattern      <- "^MT-"
logfc_threshold <- 0.25
min_pct         <- 0.25
only_positive   <- TRUE
output_file     <- "all_cluster_markers.csv"

# 1. Load data (10X MTX: barcodes.tsv, genes.tsv, matrix.mtx in working directory)
counts <- Read10X(data.dir = data_dir)
seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = project_name,
                           min.cells = min_cells, min.features = min_features)

cat("Genes:", nrow(seu), " Cells:", ncol(seu), "\n")

# 2. QC metrics
seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = mt_pattern)

VlnPlot(seu, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") +
  FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")

# 3. Filter low-quality cells
seu <- subset(seu, subset = nFeature_RNA > min_feat & nFeature_RNA < max_feat &
                percent.mt < max_mt)

cat("Cells after filtering:", ncol(seu), "\n")

# 4. Normalise
seu <- NormalizeData(seu, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# 5. Identify highly variable genes
seu <- FindVariableFeatures(seu, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = n_variable)

top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(seu), 10)
vfp <- VariableFeaturePlot(seu)
LabelPoints(plot = vfp, points = top10, repel = TRUE)

# 6. Scale data
all_genes <- rownames(seu)
seu <- ScaleData(seu, features = all_genes)

# 7. PCA
seu <- RunPCA(seu, features = VariableFeatures(seu))
print(seu[["pca"]], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)
VizDimLoadings(seu, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca")
DimPlot(seu, reduction = "pca")
ElbowPlot(seu, ndims = n_pcs)

# 8. Build neighbour graph
seu <- FindNeighbors(seu, dims = 1:n_pcs)

# 9. Cluster cells
seu <- FindClusters(seu, resolution = resolution)

# 10. UMAP
seu <- RunUMAP(seu, dims = 1:n_pcs)
DimPlot(seu, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("UMAP - PBMC clusters")

# 11. Find marker genes for every cluster
sc_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  seu,
  only.pos        = only_positive,
  min.pct         = min_pct,
  logfc.threshold = logfc_threshold,
  test.use        = "wilcox"
)

top_markers <- sc_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > logfc_threshold) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Top markers per cluster:\n")
print(top_markers)

write.csv(sc_markers, file = output_file, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Marker table saved to:", output_file, "\n")

seu_final <- seu
seu_final

doublet_rate <- 0.07

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data (manual MTX load — genes.tsv/barcodes.tsv/matrix.mtx in cwd)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
genes    <- read.delim("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------

seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = mt_pattern)

print(FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt"))
print(FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA"))

seu_filtered <- subset(
  seu,
  subset = nFeature_RNA > min_features & nFeature_RNA < max_feat & percent.mt < max_mt
)
cat("Cells before filtering:", ncol(seu), "\n")
cat("Cells after filtering: ", ncol(seu_filtered), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Variable features
# ------------------------------------------------------------
seu_filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_filtered, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = n_variable)
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(seu_filtered), 10)
p_var <- VariableFeaturePlot(seu_filtered)
print(LabelPoints(plot = p_var, points = top10, repel = TRUE))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Scale data
# ------------------------------------------------------------
all_genes <- rownames(seu_filtered)
seu_filtered <- ScaleData(seu_filtered, features = all_genes)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. PCA
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print(ElbowPlot(seu_filtered, ndims = n_pcs))
print(DimPlot(seu_filtered, reduction = "pca"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Neighbours + Clustering
# ------------------------------------------------------------
seu_filtered <- FindNeighbors(seu_filtered, dims = 1:n_pcs)
seu_filtered <- FindClusters(seu_filtered, resolution = resolution)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. UMAP
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print(DimPlot(seu_filtered, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Clusters (pre-doublet removal)"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Doublet detection with DoubletFinder
# REQUIRED INPUT: seu_filtered must already have Normalize -> VariableFeatures ->
# Scale -> PCA -> Neighbors -> Clusters -> UMAP (all done above)
# ALWAYS use run_doubletfinder_safe(), never doubletFinder() directly
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

seu_df <- run_doubletfinder_safe(
  seu          = seu_filtered,
  n_pcs        = n_pcs,
  doublet_rate = doublet_rate,
  pK           = pK_fixed,
  run_pk_sweep = run_pk_sweep
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Visualise singlets and doublets on UMAP
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if ("umap" %in% names(seu_df@reductions)) {
  print(DimPlot(seu_df, reduction = "umap", group.by = "doublet_status",
                cols = c("Singlet" = "grey70", "Doublet" = "red")) +
          ggtitle("Doublet status on UMAP"))
}

print(DimPlot(seu_df, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) +
        ggtitle("Clusters"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Remove doublets, keep singlets only
# ------------------------------------------------------------
seu_singlets <- subset(
  seu_df,
  cells = colnames(seu_df)[seu_df$doublet_status == "Singlet"]
)
cat("Singlets retained:", ncol(seu_singlets), "\n")
cat("Doublets removed: ", ncol(seu_df) - ncol(seu_singlets), "\n")

saveRDS(seu_df,       "seurat_doublet_annotated.rds")
saveRDS(seu_singlets, "seurat_singlets.rds")
write.csv(
  data.frame(cell = colnames(seu_df), doublet_status = seu_df$doublet_status),
  "doublet_calls.csv", row.names = FALSE
)
cat("Saved: seurat_doublet_annotated.rds\n")
cat("Saved: seurat_singlets.rds\n")
cat("Saved: doublet_calls.csv\n")

  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

  genes_present <- intersect(marker_sets[[ct]], rownames(seu_filtered))
  if (length(genes_present) > 0) {
    seu_filtered <- AddModuleScore(
      seu_filtered,
      features = list(genes_present),
      name     = paste0("score_", make.names(ct))
    )
  }
}

score_cols <- grep("^score_", colnames(seu_filtered@meta.data), value = TRUE)
score_cols <- score_cols[grepl("1$", score_cols)]  # AddModuleScore appends "1"

cluster_avg_scores <- seu_filtered@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(score_cols), mean), .groups = "drop")

celltype_lookup <- setNames(names(marker_sets), paste0("score_", make.names(names(marker_sets)), "1"))

cluster_labels <- apply(cluster_avg_scores[, score_cols, drop = FALSE], 1, function(row) {
  best_col <- score_cols[which.max(row)]
  celltype_lookup[[best_col]]
})
names(cluster_labels) <- as.character(cluster_avg_scores$seurat_clusters)

cat("Cluster -> cell type mapping:\n")
print(cluster_labels)

manual_labels <- cluster_labels[levels(seu_filtered)]
names(manual_labels) <- levels(seu_filtered)
seu_filtered <- RenameIdents(seu_filtered, manual_labels)
seu_filtered$cell_type <- Idents(seu_filtered)

# ============================================================
# Final annotated UMAP
# ============================================================
annotated_umap <- DimPlot(seu_filtered, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, label.size = 4.5) +
  xlab("UMAP 1") + ylab("UMAP 2") +
  ggtitle("PBMC UMAP - annotated cell types") +
  theme(axis.title  = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))

print(annotated_umap)
ggsave("PBMC_annotated_UMAP.png", annotated_umap, width = 8, height = 6)

saveRDS(seu_filtered, "seurat_pbmc_annotated.rds")
cat("Saved annotated Seurat object: seurat_pbmc_annotated.rds\n")
cat("Saved annotated UMAP plot: PBMC_annotated_UMAP.png\n")

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)

set.seed(42)

# ---------------------------
# PARAMETERS
# ---------------------------
data_dir     <- "."
project_name <- "pbmc3k"
min_cells    <- 3
min_features <- 200
min_feat     <- 200
max_feat     <- 2500
max_mt       <- 5
mt_pattern   <- "^MT-"
n_variable   <- 2000
n_pcs        <- 20
resolution   <- 0.5

# ---------------------------
# 1. Load data (manual MTX load — feature names made unique)
# ---------------------------
genes    <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "genes.tsv"), header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
barcodes <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "barcodes.tsv"), header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
counts   <- Matrix::readMM(file.path(data_dir, "matrix.mtx"))

rownames(counts) <- make.unique(as.character(genes[[2]]))  # HGNC symbols, made unique
colnames(counts) <- as.character(barcodes[[1]])

seu <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts      = counts,
  project     = project_name,
  min.cells   = min_cells,
  min.features = min_features
)

# ---------------------------
# 2. QC metrics
# ---------------------------
seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = mt_pattern)

VlnPlot(seu, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")

# ---------------------------
# 3. Filter low-quality cells
# ---------------------------
seu_filtered <- subset(
  seu,
  subset = nFeature_RNA > min_feat & nFeature_RNA < max_feat & percent.mt < max_mt
)

# ---------------------------
# 4. Normalise
# ---------------------------
seu_filtered <- NormalizeData(seu_filtered, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# ---------------------------
# 5. Variable genes
# ---------------------------
seu_filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_filtered, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = n_variable)

# ---------------------------
# 6. Scale data
# ---------------------------
all_genes <- rownames(seu_filtered)
seu_filtered <- ScaleData(seu_filtered, features = all_genes)

# ---------------------------
# 7. PCA
# ---------------------------
seu_filtered <- RunPCA(seu_filtered, features = VariableFeatures(seu_filtered))
ElbowPlot(seu_filtered, ndims = n_pcs)

# ---------------------------
# 8. Neighbours + Clustering
# ---------------------------
seu_filtered <- FindNeighbors(seu_filtered, dims = 1:n_pcs)
seu_filtered <- FindClusters(seu_filtered, resolution = resolution)

# ---------------------------
# 9. UMAP
# ---------------------------
seu_filtered <- RunUMAP(seu_filtered, dims = 1:n_pcs)
DimPlot(seu_filtered, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("PBMC clusters")

# ---------------------------
# 10. Differential expression: cluster 0 vs cluster 3
# ---------------------------
Idents(seu_filtered) <- "seurat_clusters"

de_0_vs_3 <- FindMarkers(
  seu_filtered,
  ident.1 = "0",
  ident.2 = "3",
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0.1
)

de_0_vs_3$gene <- rownames(de_0_vs_3)
write.csv(de_0_vs_3, file = "DE_cluster0_vs_cluster3.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ---------------------------
# 11. Volcano plot
# ---------------------------
de_0_vs_3 <- de_0_vs_3 %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_padj = -log10(p_val_adj),
    significant = case_when(
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 1  ~ "Up in cluster 0",
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC < -1 ~ "Up in cluster 3",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    )
  )

top_labels <- de_0_vs_3 %>%
  filter(significant != "NS") %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
  head(15)

volcano_plot <- ggplot(de_0_vs_3, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = neg_log10_padj, color = significant)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Up in cluster 0" = "red",
    "Up in cluster 3" = "blue",
    "NS" = "grey70"
  )) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = top_labels, aes(label = gene), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Differential expression: Cluster 0 vs Cluster 3",
    x = "log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-log10(adjusted p-value)",
    color = "Significance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(volcano_plot)

                               "Significant", "Not significant"))

de_results$neglog10padj <- -log10(de_results$p_val_adj)
de_results$neglog10padj[is.infinite(de_results$neglog10padj)] <- max(de_results$neglog10padj[is.finite(de_results$neglog10padj)], na.rm = TRUE)

top_labels <- de_results %>%
  filter(sig == "Significant") %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

volcano_plot <- ggplot(de_results, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = neglog10padj, color = sig)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "red", "Not significant" = "grey70")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logfc_cutoff, logfc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = top_labels, aes(label = gene), size = 3,
                            max.overlaps = 20, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Cluster 0 vs Cluster 3 - Differential Expression",
       x = "log2 Fold Change", y = "-log10(adjusted p-value)", color = "") +
  theme_minimal()

print(volcano_plot)

cat("Number of significant DE genes (|log2FC| > 1, p_adj < 0.05):",
    sum(de_results$sig == "Significant"), "\n")

plot1 <- FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")

        seu$nFeature_RNA < max_feat &

)

)

cat("Final Seurat object saved to pbmc_final.rds\n")

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                    pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                    pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

doublet_rate <- 0.07
pK_fixed     <- 0.01

cat("Cells after filtering: ", ncol(seu_filtered), "\n")

# 10. Doublet detection and removal (DoubletFinder)
# REQUIRED INPUT: seu_filtered must already have
# NormalizeData -> FindVariableFeatures -> ScaleData -> RunPCA ->
# FindNeighbors -> FindClusters -> RunUMAP  (all satisfied above)
#
# DO NOT call doubletFinder() directly. ALWAYS use run_doubletfinder_safe().
# ============================================================
run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                    pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

# ============================================================
# Single-sample scRNA-seq analysis (PBMC, raw counts) — Seurat
# Full pipeline: QC -> filtering -> normalisation -> cell cycle ->
# variable genes -> scaling -> PCA -> neighbours -> clustering ->
# UMAP -> doublet removal -> marker genes -> cell type annotation
# ============================================================

## ---- Explicitly load every package whose functions are called directly ----
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)

## ============================================================
## PARAMETERS (adjust before running)
## ============================================================
seed          <- 42            # reproducibility seed

# Input — 10X Cell Ranger MTX output expected in the working directory
# (matrix.mtx, features.tsv/genes.tsv, barcodes.tsv). Change data_dir if needed.
data_dir      <- "."
project_name  <- "PBMC"

min_cells     <- 3             # genes detected in >= this many cells
min_features  <- 200           # cells with >= this many genes

mt_pattern    <- "^MT-"        # human mitochondrial gene pattern

min_feat      <- 200           # QC filter: min genes/cell
max_feat      <- 2500          # QC filter: max genes/cell
max_mt        <- 5             # QC filter: max % mitochondrial reads

norm_method   <- "lognorm"     # "lognorm" or "sctransform"
scale_factor  <- 10000

regress_cell_cycle <- FALSE    # set TRUE to regress out cell cycle effects

n_variable    <- 2000          # highly variable genes
n_pcs_compute <- 50            # PCs to compute
n_pcs         <- 20            # PCs used downstream (adjust from elbow plot)

resolution    <- 0.5           # clustering resolution
algorithm     <- 1             # 1 = Louvain

doublet_rate  <- 0.07          # expected doublet proportion
pK_fixed      <- 0.01
run_pk_sweep  <- FALSE

annotation_method <- "manual"  # "manual" or "singler"

out_dir       <- "outputs"

## ============================================================
## Setup
## ============================================================
set.seed(seed)
cat("Seed set to:", seed, "\n")

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
sink(file.path(out_dir, "sessionInfo.txt"))
print(sessionInfo())
sink()

## ============================================================
## Step 1: Load raw counts and create Seurat object
## ============================================================
counts <- Read10X(data.dir = data_dir)
seu <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts       = counts,
  project      = project_name,
  min.cells    = min_cells,
  min.features = min_features
)
cat("Seurat object created\n")
cat("Genes:", nrow(seu), " Cells:", ncol(seu), "\n")
print(seu)

## ============================================================
## Step 2: QC metrics
## ============================================================
seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = mt_pattern)

cat("QC metric summary:\n")
print(summary(seu@meta.data[, c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt")]))

p_vln <- VlnPlot(seu, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
                  ncol = 3) + ggtitle("QC metrics (pre-filter)")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "qc_violin_prefilter.png"), p_vln, width = 12, height = 5)

p1 <- FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
p2 <- FeatureScatter(seu, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "qc_scatter_prefilter.png"), p1 + p2, width = 12, height = 5)

## ============================================================
## Step 3: Filter low-quality cells
## ============================================================
n_before <- ncol(seu)
keep <- seu$nFeature_RNA > min_feat &
        seu$nFeature_RNA < max_feat &
        seu$percent.mt   < max_mt

seu_filtered <- subset(seu, cells = colnames(seu)[keep])
cat("Cells before filtering:", n_before, "\n")
cat("Cells after filtering: ", ncol(seu_filtered), "\n")
cat("Cells removed:         ", n_before - ncol(seu_filtered), "\n")

p_vln_post <- VlnPlot(seu_filtered, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
                       ncol = 3) + ggtitle("QC metrics (post-filter)")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "qc_violin_postfilter.png"), p_vln_post, width = 12, height = 5)

saveRDS(seu_filtered, file.path(out_dir, "seurat_filtered.rds"))

## ============================================================
## Step 4: Normalisation
## ============================================================
if (norm_method == "lognorm") {
  seu_filtered <- NormalizeData(seu_filtered, normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                                 scale.factor = scale_factor)
  cat("Log-normalisation complete\n")
} else if (norm_method == "sctransform") {
  seu_filtered <- SCTransform(seu_filtered, verbose = FALSE)
  cat("SCTransform normalisation complete\n")
} else {
  stop("norm_method must be 'lognorm' or 'sctransform'")
}

## ============================================================
## Step 5: Cell cycle scoring (after normalisation)
## ============================================================
s_genes   <- Seurat::cc.genes$s.genes
g2m_genes <- Seurat::cc.genes$g2m.genes

seu_filtered <- CellCycleScoring(
  seu_filtered,
  s.features   = s_genes,
  g2m.features = g2m_genes,
  set.ident    = FALSE
)
cat("Cell cycle phase distribution:\n")
print(table(seu_filtered$Phase))

## ============================================================
## Step 6: Highly variable genes
## ============================================================
if (norm_method == "lognorm") {
  seu_filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_filtered, selection.method = "vst",
                                        nfeatures = n_variable)
  top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(seu_filtered), 10)
  cat("Top 10 variable genes:", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")

  p_var <- VariableFeaturePlot(seu_filtered)
  p_var <- LabelPoints(plot = p_var, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "variable_features.png"), p_var, width = 8, height = 6)
}

## ============================================================
## Step 7: Scale data
## ============================================================
vars_to_regress <- if (regress_cell_cycle) c("percent.mt", "S.Score", "G2M.Score") else "percent.mt"

if (norm_method == "lognorm") {
  seu_filtered <- ScaleData(
    seu_filtered,
    features        = VariableFeatures(seu_filtered),
    vars.to.regress = vars_to_regress
  )
  cat("Scaling complete\n")
}

## ============================================================
## Step 8: PCA
## ============================================================
seu_filtered <- RunPCA(
  seu_filtered,
  features = VariableFeatures(object = seu_filtered),
  npcs     = n_pcs_compute,
  verbose  = FALSE
)

p_elbow <- ElbowPlot(seu_filtered, ndims = n_pcs_compute) +
  ggtitle("Elbow plot — choose n_pcs")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "pca_elbow_plot.png"), p_elbow, width = 7, height = 5)

p_pca <- DimPlot(seu_filtered, reduction = "pca") + NoLegend() + ggtitle("PCA")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "pca_plot.png"), p_pca, width = 7, height = 6)

## ============================================================
## Step 9: Neighbours
## ============================================================
seu_filtered <- FindNeighbors(seu_filtered, dims = 1:n_pcs, reduction = "pca", verbose = FALSE)
cat("kNN/SNN graph built using", n_pcs, "PCs\n")

## ============================================================
## Step 10: Clustering
## ============================================================
seu_filtered <- FindClusters(seu_filtered, resolution = resolution, algorithm = algorithm,
                              verbose = FALSE)
cat("Cluster sizes:\n")
print(table(Idents(seu_filtered)))

## ============================================================
## Step 11: UMAP
## ============================================================
seu_filtered <- RunUMAP(seu_filtered, dims = 1:n_pcs, reduction = "pca", verbose = FALSE)

p_umap_clusters <- DimPlot(seu_filtered, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle(paste0("UMAP — clusters (res = ", resolution, ")"))
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "umap_clusters.png"), p_umap_clusters, width = 7, height = 6)

saveRDS(seu_filtered, file.path(out_dir, "seurat_clustered.rds"))

## ============================================================
## Step 12: Doublet detection and removal (DoubletFinder)
## ============================================================
run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                    pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

seu_df <- run_doubletfinder_safe(
  seu          = seu_filtered,
  n_pcs        = n_pcs,
  doublet_rate = doublet_rate,
  pK           = pK_fixed,
  run_pk_sweep = run_pk_sweep
)

if ("umap" %in% names(seu_df@reductions)) {
  p_doublet <- DimPlot(seu_df, reduction = "umap", group.by = "doublet_status") +
    ggtitle("Doublet status")
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "umap_doublet_status.png"), p_doublet, width = 7, height = 6)
}

seu_singlets <- subset(seu_df, cells = colnames(seu_df)[seu_df$doublet_status == "Singlet"])
cat("Singlets retained:", ncol(seu_singlets), "\n")
cat("Doublets removed: ", ncol(seu_df) - ncol(seu_singlets), "\n")

saveRDS(seu_df,       file.path(out_dir, "seurat_doublet_annotated.rds"))
saveRDS(seu_singlets, file.path(out_dir, "seurat_singlets.rds"))
write.csv(
  data.frame(cell = colnames(seu_df), doublet_status = seu_df$doublet_status),
  file.path(out_dir, "doublet_calls.csv"), row.names = FALSE
)

## Continue downstream analysis on singlets only
seu_filtered <- seu_singlets

## ============================================================
## Step 13: Marker gene identification
## ============================================================
sc_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  seu_filtered,
  only.pos        = TRUE,
  min.pct         = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  test.use        = "wilcox"
)

top_markers <- sc_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > 0.25) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  ungroup()
cat("Top markers per cluster:\n")
print(top_markers)

write.csv(sc_markers, file.path(out_dir, "all_cluster_markers.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# PBMC canonical marker genes
feature_genes <- c("MS4A1", "GNLY", "CD3E", "CD14", "FCER1A",
                    "FCGR3A", "LYZ", "PPBP", "CD8A")

p_feat <- FeaturePlot(seu_filtered, features = feature_genes)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "marker_featureplot.png"), p_feat, width = 12, height = 10)

p_vln_markers <- VlnPlot(seu_filtered, features = feature_genes)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "marker_violinplot.png"), p_vln_markers, width = 12, height = 10)

top_heatmap <- sc_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > 0.25) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

p_heat <- DoHeatmap(seu_filtered, features = top_heatmap$gene) + NoLegend()
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "marker_heatmap.png"), p_heat, width = 10, height = 12)

## ============================================================
## Step 14: Cell type annotation
## ============================================================
if (annotation_method == "manual") {
  # PBMC canonical cluster -> cell type mapping.
  # Inspect marker_featureplot.png / all_cluster_markers.csv and adjust these
  # labels so they match the number/order of clusters actually produced.
  cluster_levels <- levels(Idents(seu_filtered))
  pbmc_reference <- c("Naive CD4+ T", "CD14+ Mono", "Memory CD4+ T", "B cell",
                       "CD8+ T", "FCGR3A+ Mono", "NK cell", "Dendritic cell", "Platelet")
  manual_labels <- setNames(
    pbmc_reference[seq_along(cluster_levels)],
    cluster_levels
  )
  manual_labels[is.na(manual_labels)] <- paste0("Cluster_", names(manual_labels)[is.na(manual_labels)])

  seu_filtered <- RenameIdents(seu_filtered, manual_labels)
  seu_filtered$cell_type <- Idents(seu_filtered)

  p_annot <- DimPlot(seu_filtered, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, label.size = 4.5) +
    xlab("UMAP 1") + ylab("UMAP 2") +
    ggtitle("UMAP — manual PBMC cell type annotation")
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "umap_celltype_annotation.png"), p_annot, width = 8, height = 7)

} else if (annotation_method == "singler") {
  library(SingleR)
  library(celldex)

  if (inherits(seu_filtered[["RNA"]], "Assay5")) {
    seu_filtered[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seu_filtered[["RNA"]])
  }

  ref <- HumanPrimaryCellAtlasData()
  DefaultAssay(seu_filtered) <- "RNA"
  rna_matrix <- GetAssayData(seu_filtered, layer = "data")

  singler_results <- SingleR(test = rna_matrix, ref = ref, labels = ref$label.main)
  seu_filtered <- AddMetaData(seu_filtered, metadata = singler_results$labels,

  p_annot <- DimPlot(seu_filtered, reduction = "umap", group.by = "SingleR_Labels", label = TRUE) +
    ggtitle("UMAP — SingleR cell type annotation")
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "umap_celltype_annotation.png"), p_annot, width = 8, height = 7)
}

library(Matrix)
