# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(42)

# PARAMETERS
data_dir <- "."
project_name <- "PBMC"
min_cells <- 3
min_features <- 200
mt_pattern <- "^MT-"
min_feat <- 200
max_feat <- 2500
max_mt <- 5
n_variable <- 2000
n_pcs_compute <- 50
n_pcs_print <- 5
n_features_print <- 5

# Step 1: Load MTX files
genes <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "genes.tsv"), header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
barcodes <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "barcodes.tsv"), header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
counts <- Matrix::readMM(file.path(data_dir, "matrix.mtx"))

# Assign unique row and column names
rownames(counts) <- make.unique(as.character(genes[[1]]))
colnames(counts) <- as.character(barcodes[[1]])

# Step 2: Create Seurat object
seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = project_name,
                          min.cells = min_cells, min.features = min_features)

cat("Seurat object created\n")
cat("Genes: ", nrow(seu), "\n")
cat("Cells: ", ncol(seu), "\n")

# Step 3: Compute QC metrics
seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = mt_pattern)

cat("QC metrics computed. Summary:\n")
print(summary(seu@meta.data[, c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt")]))

# Step 4: Filter cells
n_before <- ncol(seu)
keep <- seu$nFeature_RNA > min_feat &
        seu$nFeature_RNA < max_feat &
        seu$percent.mt < max_mt

seu <- subset(seu, cells = colnames(seu)[keep])

cat("Cells before filtering:", n_before, "\n")
cat("Cells after filtering: ", ncol(seu), "\n")
cat("Cells removed:         ", n_before - ncol(seu), "\n")

# Step 5: Normalise data
seu <- NormalizeData(seu, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
cat("Log-normalisation complete\n")

# Step 6: Find variable features
seu <- FindVariableFeatures(seu, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = n_variable)

top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(seu), 10)
cat("Top 10 variable genes:", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Step 7: Scale data
seu <- ScaleData(seu, features = VariableFeatures(seu))
cat("Scaling complete\n")

# Step 8: Run PCA
seu <- RunPCA(seu, features = VariableFeatures(seu), npcs = n_pcs_compute, verbose = FALSE)

# Print top gene loadings
print(seu[["pca"]], dims = 1:n_pcs_print, nfeatures = n_features_print)

# Step 9: Visualisations
VizDimLoadings(seu, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca")
DimPlot(seu, reduction = "pca") + NoLegend()
DimHeatmap(seu, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)

# Step 10: Elbow plot
ElbowPlot(seu, ndims = n_pcs_compute)

seu <- FindVariableFeatures(seu, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

seu <- RunPCA(seu, features = VariableFeatures(seu), npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)

# Manual cell type annotation using marker genes

  "CD4 T cells" = c("IL7R", "CCR7"),
  "CD14 Monocytes" = c("CD14", "LYZ"),
  "B cells" = c("MS4A1"),
  "CD8 T cells" = c("CD8A"),
  "NK cells" = c("GNLY", "NKG7")
)

# Calculate average expression per cluster for each marker set
avg_exp <- AverageExpression(seu, assays = "RNA")$RNA

# For each cluster, find best matching cell type
cluster_labels <- rep(NA, length(levels(seu$seurat_clusters)))
names(cluster_labels) <- levels(seu$seurat_clusters)

for (cluster in levels(seu$seurat_clusters)) {
  cluster_idx <- as.numeric(cluster) + 1
  if (cluster_idx > nrow(avg_exp)) next
  
  cluster_profile <- avg_exp[, cluster_idx]
  
  best_type <- NA
  best_score <- -Inf

      }
    }

    cluster_labels[cluster] <- best_type

}

  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "gray60", "TRUE" = "red"),

  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pval_threshold),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  xlab("log2(Fold Change)") +
  ylab("-log10(adjusted p-value)") +
  ggtitle("Volcano Plot: Cluster 0 vs Cluster 3") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(

    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()

n_sig_down <- sum(de_markers$sig & de_markers$avg_log2FC < 0)

cat("\n=== DOUBLET DETECTION ===\n")
run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, pN = 0.25, pK = as.numeric(pK),
                                 nExp = n_exp_adj, reuse.pANN = NULL, sct = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

seu_df <- run_doubletfinder_safe(seu = seu, n_pcs = n_pcs, doublet_rate = doublet_rate,

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw): ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, pN = 0.25, pK = as.numeric(pK),
                                 nExp = n_exp_adj, reuse.pANN = NULL, sct = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) 0
  )

  n_exp <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, pN = 0.25, pK = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp = n_exp_adj, reuse.pANN = NULL, sct = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK:", pK)
  }

  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed:", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted):", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed:", e$message, ". Using fallback.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 20, doublet_rate = 0.07,
                                   pK = 0.01, run_pk_sweep = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (isTRUE(run_pk_sweep)) {
    sweep.res   <- DoubletFinder::paramSweep(seu, PCs = 1:n_pcs, sct = FALSE)
    sweep.stats <- DoubletFinder::summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
    bcmvn       <- DoubletFinder::find.pK(sweep.stats)
    pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
    message("Optimal pK: ", pK)
  }

  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs = 1:n_pcs,
      pN = 0.25,
      pK = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}

        sct        = (norm_method == "sctransform")
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
        message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
        seu_obj$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
        return(seu_obj)
      }
    )
    
    df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
    df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA
    
    if (is.na(df_col)) {
      message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
      seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    } else {
      seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
      print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
    }
    
    return(seu_df)
  }
  
  seu <- run_doubletfinder_safe(seu, n_pcs = n_pcs_use, 
                                 doublet_rate = doublet_rate, 
                                 pK = pK_fixed)
  
  if ("doublet_status" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    p_db <- DimPlot(seu, reduction = "umap", group.by = "doublet_status") +
      ggtitle("Doublet Detection")
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "10_doublet_status.pdf"), p_db, width = 10, height = 8)
    
    seu_singlets <- subset(seu, cells = colnames(seu)[seu$doublet_status == "Singlet"])
    cat("Singlets retained:", ncol(seu_singlets), "\n")
    cat("Doublets removed: ", ncol(seu) - ncol(seu_singlets), "\n")
    seu <- seu_singlets
  }

library(Seurat)

max_mt       <- 5              # mitochondrial percentage

max_feat     <- 2500           # maximum genes per cell

# Normalization

scale_factor <- 10000

# Feature selection and scaling

scale_all_genes <- FALSE
vars_to_regress <- NULL        # e.g. c("percent.mt")

# Cell cycle (optional)

# Dimensionality reduction

# Clustering

algorithm    <- 1              # 1 = Louvain

cat("\n=== STEP 12: Detecting doublets ===\n")

run_doubletfinder_safe <- function(seu, n_pcs = 10, doublet_rate = 0.07, pK = 0.01) {
  if (!requireNamespace("DoubletFinder", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("DoubletFinder not installed. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    message("No seurat_clusters found. Marking all cells as Singlet.")
    seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
    return(seu)
  }

  annotations    <- as.character(seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters)
  homotypic_prop <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::modelHomotypic(annotations),
    error = function(e) { message("modelHomotypic failed: ", e$message); 0 }
  )

  n_exp     <- round(doublet_rate * ncol(seu))
  n_exp_adj <- round(n_exp * (1 - homotypic_prop))
  message("Expected doublets (raw):      ", n_exp)
  message("Expected doublets (adjusted): ", n_exp_adj)

  seu_df <- tryCatch(
    DoubletFinder::doubletFinder(
      seu,
      PCs        = 1:n_pcs,
      pN         = 0.25,
      pK         = as.numeric(pK),
      nExp       = n_exp_adj,
      reuse.pANN = NULL,
      sct        = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("doubletFinder() failed: ", e$message)
      message("Fallback: marking all cells as Singlet.")
      seu$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
      return(seu)
    }
  )

  df_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(seu_df@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df_col <- if (length(df_col) > 0) df_col[1] else NA

  if (is.na(df_col)) {
    message("No DF.classifications column found. Using fallback.")
    seu_df$doublet_status <- "Singlet"
  } else {
    seu_df$doublet_status <- as.character(seu_df@meta.data[[df_col]])
    print(table(seu_df$doublet_status))
  }

  return(seu_df)
}
